transcript:
Agent: Good morning, Mrs. Lakshmi Sharma? My name is Vikram from XYZ Bank. I'm calling regarding your personal loan account number ending in 8901. Your EMI of fifteen thousand rupees was due on the fifth of this month, and we show it as unpaid. Are you aware of this outstanding amount?
Customer: Oh, yes, good morning. Hmm. Lakshmi here. My payment? Yes, I know. Problem is, my… uh, salary, it's not… fully arrive, no. Very delay this month, you see? My company, it always do like this.
Agent: Okay, I understand. You're saying your salary is delayed. When do you expect it to be credited, Mrs. Sharma? Can we expect the full fifteen thousand rupees by... end of the week, maybe? So we can arrange your payment from there.
Customer: End of the week? No, no, sir. It is not this week. It is more… you know, like second week. The office, they promise. It is always like this. So EMI, I will... pay when full money arrive. It's difficult now, no funds.
Agent: When you say 'second week', do you mean next week? Or the week after that? Just to confirm the date, can you tell me an exact date, please? So we can mark it for payment and avoid further late fees on the fifteen thousand, madam.
Customer: Date, date. Hmm. See, this office problem, it is very bad. My manager, he told me… he will inform me. So… I cannot say particular date. But it is always mid-month, you know. I will call you then.
Agent: Okay, Mrs. Sharma, I am finding it a little difficult to understand the exact date you are committing to. It sounds like you are saying 'mid-month', but the exact week or date is not completely clear. Would you prefer if I arranged for someone who can speak to you in Kannada? Sometimes it's easier to discuss these things in your native language to avoid confusion.
Customer: Oh. Kannada? Yes, yes. That will be very good. My Kannada speaking, he will understand better my situation. Please, yes, you do that.
Agent: Excellent. I will arrange a warm transfer to our Kannada-speaking team member for you, Mrs. Sharma. Please hold for just a moment while I connect you.

Agent: Namaste. Mai Rajesh, SecureLoan Finance se bol raha hoon. Kya meri baat Mohan Lal ji se ho rahi hai? Aapka loan account number hai 98765. Aapki EMI Rs. 35,500 pending hai jo 15 June ko due thi. Kya aap mujhe sun pa rahe hain, Mohan Lal ji?Customer: Haan ji, Mohan Lal bol raha hoon. Par abhi main busy tha yaar, aur yeh kaisa loan hai? Maine toh sab clear kar diya tha. Aur aap log, yaar, har roz phone kar dete ho! Agent: Ji Mohan Lal ji, main samajh sakta hoon ki aap busy hain. Par sir, yeh aapka two wheeler loan account number 98765 hai, jismein three EMIs se zyada ka outstanding chal raha hai. Aapka total amount including late fees ab Rs. 1,05,000 se upar ho chuka hai. Isi karan aapko hamari legal department ki taraf se ek demand notice bhi bheja gaya tha pichle hafte. Kya woh notice aapko prapt hua hai sir? Customer: Oh, woh wala? Haan, woh postcard jaisa kuch aaya toh tha ghar pe. Mere bete ne dekha tha. Bola tha ki court-wourt ka kuch hai... maine zyada padha nahi. Ab yeh court kahan se aa gaya beech mein? Matlab kya hai iska?Agent: Ji Mohan Lal ji, bilkul sahi pehchaana apne. Uss notice mein saaf likha hai ki agar aapki teen se zyada EMIs outstanding rehti hain toh hume legal kaaryawahi shuru karni padti hai. Ismein aapke credit score pe bhi bahut bura asar padega. Kya aapke paas woh notice abhi paas mein hai, ya main aapko uski ek brief jaankari de sakta hoon? Kyunki sir, yeh bahut serious matter hai. Aapko kab tak payment karne ka kuch idea hai? Customer: Kya serious matter hai? Yaar jab dekho tab dhamki dete rehte ho. Dekho, paise hain nahi abhi. Aur doosre bank ki EMI bhi jaani hai is mahine. Salary thodi delayed hai is baar, agle hafte tak aayegi. Toh abhi toh nahi ho paayega. Bilkul nahi ho paayega. Agent: Mohan Lal ji, please shant ho jaiye. Dhamki nahi hai sir, yeh kewal aapke liye information hai. Hum chahte hain ki aapki file pe koi legal action na ho. Toh theek hai, aapke hisaab se phir yeh Rs. 1,05,000 ka full outstanding amount kab tak kar paayenge aap? Aur main aapki notice acknowledgement record kar leta hoon ki aapko woh prapt ho gaya hai.Customer: Haan, mil gaya hai, theek hai. Likh lo aap. Mil gaya hai notice. Ab dekho... salary aa jaaye toh shayad agle mahine ki 5 tareekh tak thode-thode kar ke daal doonga. Pura toh nahi ho paayega ek saath. Baaki kuch settle-wettle karwa sakte ho kya? Ya penalty kam ho jaaye thodi? Agent: Okay, theek hai Mohan Lal ji. Aapne notice receive kar liya hai, hum isse note kar lete hain apne system mein. Aur aapne kaha ki next month ki 5th tak aap payment try karoge, right? Full ya partial? Customer: Partial hi ho payega bhaiyya. Abhi filhaal toh wahi ho sakta hai. Aur please yaar, zyada calls mat kiya karo din mein. Bas ek hi baar phone karna, main pick kar loonga.
L3: Broken & Vague Commitments|Commitment & Salary|Complaints & DNC|Hardship & Vulnerability|Identity & Verification|Legal & Regulatory|Settlement & Negotiation

transcript:
Agent: Good morning Chirag Shah ji, this is Ravi from our NPA Recovery team.
<noise>background traffic sound</noise>
Customer: NPA team matlab? Kitna serious hai yeh?
Agent: Chirag Shah ji, your microfinance loan account has crossed 180 days overdue — total outstanding with interest is 7,200. We are offering a one-time settlement at 2,520 rupees.
Customer: 2,520 bhi bohot zyada hai. Main financially bahut struggle kar raha/rahi hoon. Agar 1,764 mein ho sake toh consider karunga/karungi.
Agent: Chirag Shah ji, 1,764 possible nahi hai. Maximum discount already diya hua hai. 3,240 — final.
Customer: 3,240... theek hai, agar installment mein de sakta/sakti hoon? 3 installments mein?
Agent: 2 installments maximum — 50% now, 50% in 30 days. Kya agree hai?
Customer: Deal. Pehli installment 20th ko. Agreement letter bhejo email pe.
Agent: Sending now Chirag Shah ji. Thank you for resolving this.
Customer: App abhi jis vyakti ko call kar rahe hain vo abhi uttar nahi de rahe. Kripya thodi der baad dobara call karein.
Customer: Aapne jo number dial kiya hai woh abhi switched off hai ya coverage area se bahar hai. Kripya baad mein dobara call karein.

Agent: Good afternoon, my name is Priya from CashFlow Loans. Am I speaking with Mrs. Neha Sharma regarding your personal loan account number PL-1234567?
Customer: Yes, this is Neha speaking. What is it about?
Agent: Ma'am, your EMI of Rupees five thousand five hundred for your loan account PL-1234567, which was due on October 5th, is still showing as outstanding in our records.
Customer: Oh, five thousand five hundred? But I already paid my EMI! It was Rupees five thousand, and I made the payment on October 4th itself, well before the due date. Why is there an extra five hundred Rupees showing? I don't recall any extra charges.
Agent: Ma'am, according to our system, there is an amount of five hundred Rupees applied as a late payment charge and interest since the payment reflected late in our system, showing it was not cleared by the due date. The total outstanding is currently five thousand five hundred.
Customer: No, this is wrong. I definitely paid on the 4th, I even have the SMS confirmation. Why should I pay a late fee when I paid on time? Can you please check your records properly? I would also like to see a full statement or a ledger entry for this payment and the charges, I want to understand how this extra amount came about.
Agent: Understood, Ma'am. I can see you are disputing this charge. I will certainly send you an updated statement showing the transaction details and the applied charges to your registered email address. Please allow 24 hours for it to reach you. Until then, your current outstanding will remain under dispute.
Customer: Okay, please send it soon. I will only proceed with payment after I review the statement and understand these charges. If I paid on time, then this extra five hundred should not be there.
Agent: Noted, Ma'am. We will send the statement and wait for your review. We will call you again after 24-48 hours to follow up. Thank you for your time.
Customer: Thank you.
Customer: The number you have dialled does not exist. Please check the number and try again.

Agent: Namaste, am I speaking with Rajesh Kumar?

Customer: Haan, yes, speaking. Who is this?

Agent: Sir, this is Priya calling from Lakshmi Finance. I'm calling regarding your loan account ending in 4287. You have an outstanding balance of Rs 1,47,500 and your EMI of Rs 12,000 was due on the 15th of last month. I wanted to understand your situation and see how we can help you clear this.

Customer: See, I've already told someone from your office about this. I've been called four times this week alone. Four times! It's harassment, yaar. I'm busy with my work, and every time my phone rings, it's you people.

Agent: I understand, sir, and I apologise for the inconvenience. But we do need to resolve this outstanding amount. Can you tell me when you'll be able to make the payment?

Customer: That's the thing — I don't have the money right now. My salary was supposed to come on the 10th, but there's some delay with the company. The finance department said maybe by next week, but I can't promise anything. And honestly, I'm tired of explaining this to different people every single time.

Agent: I completely understand, sir. So once your salary comes, you'll be able to clear the dues?

Customer: Maybe. But look, I want to speak to someone senior about this. A manager or someone from the grievance team. I don't want to keep repeating myself to every agent who calls. This is becoming very frustrating. I want written communication only — email or something official. Can you arrange that?

Agent: Of course, sir. I can note that down for you. But before I escalate, can I just confirm your current email address so we can send you official correspondence?

Customer: It's rajesh.kumar1985 at gmail dot com. But I'm serious — I want this handled by someone at a higher level. Not just another junior agent calling me every other day. And I want everything in writing so there's a proper record.

Agent: Absolutely, sir. I've made a note of your request. I'm going to escalate this to our senior collections team and our grievance cell right away. They will be in touch with you within 24 hours, and all future communication will be via email unless you specifically request a call. We will also ensure that your account is flagged to reduce the call frequency while your case is being reviewed at the senior level.

Customer: Thank you. And please make sure it's actually done this time. I don't want to receive three more calls before anyone senior gets back to me.

Agent: You have my word, sir. I'm creating an escalation ticket right now, and it will be flagged as urgent. The grievance cell will contact you by email within 24 hours, and they'll take it from there. Is there anything else I should note before I close this ticket?

Customer: No, that's all. Just please make sure someone actually calls me back. And remember — email only going forward.

Agent: Noted, sir. Thank you for your patience, and I sincerely apologize for the repeated calls. Your escalation is now live in the system. You'll hear from our senior team very soon. Have a good day.
L3: Broken & Vague Commitments|Commitment & Salary|Complaints & DNC|Identity & Verification

transcript:
Agent: Hello Sunita Joshi, this is Divya from Collections.
Customer: Hi. I was actually planning to call you. I want to understand — what is the settlement option for my credit card outstanding account?
Agent: Sunita Joshi, your outstanding is currently 5,600 rupees. Settlement offers depend on your DPD and repayment history. Typically we can go down to 50-60% as a one-time full settlement.
Customer: Hmm. That would mean roughly 3,080 to 3,360? I have multiple loans with other lenders too — I am trying to close them one by one. Can I get the exact settlement amount in writing?
Agent: Yes, I can send a formal settlement offer letter via email. It will be valid for 30 days.
Customer: Please do. Once I review it I will confirm within the week.

Agent: Namaste, mera naam Amit hai. Kya main Priya Sharma ji se baat kar raha hoon? Customer: Haan, main Priya bol rahi hoon. Kaho. Agent: Priya ji, main 'Finance Seva' se call kar raha hoon aapke personal loan account number XXXX0123 ke regarding. Aapki 15,000 rupaye ki EMI jo 15 August ko due thi, woh abhi tak pending hai. Kya aap bata sakti hain ki payment kab tak expect kar sakte hain? Customer: (Awaaz mein thodi si kapkapi) Amit ji... uhh... main thode mushkil daur se guzar rahi hoon. Pata nahi kaise manage karoon... Agent: Ji Priya ji, main samajh sakta hoon. Kya koi financial problem hai jiske karan payment nahi ho pa rahi hai? Ya koi aur reason hai? Customer: Financial... haan... aur... pata nahi, pichle kuch hafte se na, mann nahi lag raha hai. Bas aise hi thodi pareshan hoon... sab kuch manage karna itna mushkil lag raha hai aaj kal. Main koshish kar rahi hoon, lekin bas... samjh nahi aa raha. Agent: Priya ji, aapki baat sunke mujhe samajh aa raha hai ki aap thoda pareshan hain. Dekhiye, agar aapko koi dikkat ho rahi hai toh hum help kar sakte hain. Aisi situation mein humare paas ek special support team hai jo aise cases handle karti hai. Main aapke account par yeh note kar deta hoon ki aapko emotional support ki zaroorat hai. Kuch dino ke liye standard calls roke jayenge, aur aapko hamari special team se koi call kar sakte hain. Kya yeh theek rahega aapke liye? Customer: Hmm... special team? Aur calls... thoda kam ho jaye toh achcha hoga. Bohut calls aa rahe hain, main handle nahi kar pa rahi. Agent: Bilkul Priya ji. Hum samjh sakte hain. Main abhi aapka account flag kar deta hoon vulnerability ke liye, aur humari empathetic team aapse contact karegi. Aap bas apna dhyaan rakhiye. Koi aur immediate help chahiye ho toh bataiyega. Customer: Shukriya. Agent: Aapka din shubh ho Priya ji. Thank you for your time. Bye.

Agent: Namaste, is this Rajesh Kumar speaking? This is calling from Fintech Solutions regarding your loan account.

Customer: Haan, this is Rajesh. But listen, I don't think I should be paying anything right now. There's something wrong with your records.

Agent: Okay, no problem. Let me help you. I'm looking at your account here. You have an outstanding balance of Rs. 45,680 against your personal loan account number FL-2024-891. The due date was 15th of this month. Can you tell me what the issue is?

Customer: See, the problem is not with me. The problem is with your company and the credit bureau. Three weeks back, I checked my CIBIL report, and it's showing that I'm defaulting on this loan. But I have been making payments! I paid in June, I paid in July... everything on time. Phir suddenly yeh notification aaya that I'm in default. How can this be?

Agent: I understand your frustration, Rajesh. Let me check the payment history here. <interruption> Yes, I can see payments received in June and July. So the reporting to the credit bureau... can you tell me exactly what it's showing?

Customer: It's showing that I missed payments from May onwards. But I didn't miss May! I made that payment too. Maybe there was a delay in your system updating, but the bureau should not be showing me as a defaulter. My credit score has dropped 80 points because of this. How am I supposed to get a credit card or anything now?

Agent: I see. So you're saying the account is showing as defaulted on CIBIL, but your actual payment record with us is clean. Is that correct?

Customer: Exactly! That's exactly what I'm saying. And I'm not going to make any more payments until this is fixed. Why should I pay when you people have already destroyed my credit profile? First, get your bureau reporting corrected. Once that's done, I'll make the payment. But not before.

Agent: Rajesh, I completely understand your concern. This is a serious issue. Let me be clear — I can see your payments here in our system, and you're right, they were on time. The discrepancy between our records and what CIBIL is showing needs to be investigated. <interruption>

Customer: Haan, so what will you do about it? How long will this take? Because I'm telling you, until the bureau shows me as current, I'm not paying. I don't want my credit score getting worse. And frankly, I'm thinking of filing a complaint with the RBI about this. Your company made a mistake, not me.

Agent: Rajesh, I'm not saying you made a mistake. I believe there's a reporting error here. Let me escalate this to our verification team. They will contact CIBIL and check what's been reported against your account. Once we identify the discrepancy, we can file a dispute with the bureau to get it corrected.

Customer: How long does that take?

Agent: Usually, it can take 30 to 45 days for a bureau correction to process. But <interruption> — I'm not going to lie to you, Rajesh. It can be faster if the error is clear-cut.

Customer: 30 to 45 days? No, no. That's too long. And meanwhile, you people keep calling me saying I'm defaulting. This is not fair. I want the bureau correction done first, then I'll pay. That's my final word.

Agent: I understand. Let me note this down. You're requesting that we file a bureau correction dispute with CIBIL before you make any payment. Is that correct?

Customer: Yes. Exactly. Get the reporting corrected, show me proof that CIBIL has received the correction request, and then we can talk about payment.

Agent: Okay, Rajesh. I'm going to escalate this today itself to our verification and bureau team. They will review your account, identify the error, and file a correction request with CIBIL. Once that's submitted, you'll receive a reference number from us. Can I get your email ID to send you the escalation confirmation?

Customer: Haan, it's rajesh.kumar.1987@gmail.com. But please, make sure this gets done quickly. And don't call me every day asking for payment until this is resolved.

Agent: Absolutely. I'm also making a note that you don't want frequent contact calls until the bureau correction is processed. This is on record now. We will reach out to you once the correction has been filed with CIBIL. Thank you for your patience, Rajesh.

Customer: Okay. But seriously, if this doesn't get resolved in the next two weeks, I will file a formal complaint. I've already lost trust in your system.

Agent: I hear you. We'll get this sorted. Let me confirm your number — it's 98765-43210?

Customer: Yes, that's correct. Okay, I'm waiting for your update then.

Agent: Thank you, Rajesh. We'll be in touch very soon.
L3: Broken & Vague Commitments|Dispute - Bureau & Claims|Identity & Verification|Legal & Regulatory

transcript: Agent: Namaste sir, mera naam Aarti hai, X Finance se. Anil Sharma ji se baat ho rahi hai? Customer: Ji, main Anil Sharma bol raha hoon. Kahiye Aarti ji. Agent: Anil ji, aapki loan account number 9876543210 par, aapka EMI due hai 15,000 rupaye ka, jo is mahine ki 5 tareekh ko due tha. Aapka account Mid Bucket mein aa gaya hai kyuki yeh aapka doosra overdue EMI hai. Aapne abhi tak payment nahi kiya hai, toh uske liye call kiya tha. Customer: Ji, pata hai mujhe, aur isi liye main thoda pareshan bhi hoon. Main dekhiye, aapko sach bata raha hoon. Pichle teen char mahine se meri jo choti dukaan hai, usme bohot mandhi chal rahi hai. Sales bilkul theek nahi hain. Poora dhandha hi baith gaya hai, samjhiye. Meri income itni buri tarah affect hui hai ki iss baar toh payment karna bohot mushkil ho raha hai. Maine socha tha ki kaise bhi karunga, par nahi ho paya. Aur upar se jo late payment ke charges lage honge, woh alag. Agent: Theek hai Anil ji, main aapki baat samajh rahi hoon. Yeh toh mushkil situation hai. Par EMI toh aapko bharni padegi sir, warna aapka credit score par aur asar padega. Kya aap aaj hi payment kar sakte hain? Ya kam se kam kuch partial amount? Customer: Aarti ji, main agar aaj kar paata toh kar deta. Isliye main aapse call pe baat kar raha hoon ki kya isme koi solution hai? Meri income abhi bilkul bhi stable nahi hai. Main chahta hoon ki aap log meri madad karein. Kya aap meri EMI thodi kam kar sakte hain, ya phir tenure badha sakte hain? Ya phir agar kuch mahino ke liye ek moratorium mil jaye toh bohot badi madad ho jayegi. Dekhiye, main payment karna chahta hoon par ek saath 15,000 rupaye aur jo extra charges hain, woh abhi mushkil hai. Kuch interest aur penalty charges bhi lage honge, kya woh maaf ho sakte hain ya kam kiye ja sakte hain? Agent: Ji Anil ji, main samajh gayi. Aap loan restructure karana chahte hain aur EMI kam karwana chahte hain. Aapko pehle ek application deni hogi, aur phir hamari team usko review karegi. Hamare paas aise options available hain jisme aap apni EMI kam karwa sakte hain ya tenure badhwa sakte hain. Aur agar hardship genuine hai, toh kuch penalty charges mein relief mil sakta hai. Main aapki request aage forward kar deti hoon. Aapko apni identity confirm karni hogi bas abhi. Customer: Ji theek hai, bataye. Mera adhaar number bataun? Aur mujhe kab tak reply milega iska? Aur please jaldi karwaiyega, bohot zyada tension ho rahi hai is cheez ki. Agent: Ji sir, abhi ke liye aapko apna pura naam aur janm tithi confirm karni hogi. Baaki documents jo bhi chahiye honge, hum aapko SMS par bhej denge. Isme 3 se 5 working days lag sakte hain. Hum try karenge ki aapko maximum relief mil sake. Toh aapka pura naam, Anil Sharma? Aur aapki janm tithi kya hai? Customer: Haan, mera pura naam Anil Sharma hai. Aur janm tithi hai 12 March 1980. Agent: Ji Anil ji, main confirm kar rahi hoon aapka identity. Don't worry, hum jald se jald aapki request ko review karwa lenge. Aapki request ko 'Hardship – Requesting Restructure / Relief' mein log kar rahe hain. Hamari team aapko jald hi sampark karegi. Theek hai sir? Customer: Ji, theek hai. Dhanyawaad. Agent: Shukriya Anil ji, din shubh ho.

Agent: Hello Ramchandra Ingle ji, main Tanvi bol raha/rahi hoon FinServe se.
Customer: Haan... haan boliye.
Agent: Ramchandra Ingle ji, aapka vehicle loan account — 9,800 rupees — pending hai. Kya baat kar sakte hain?
Customer: Main... main bahut mushkil mein hoon. Ghar mein kafi problems chal rahi hain. Main abhi sahi se soch bhi nahi pa raha/rahi.
Agent: Ramchandra Ingle ji, aap theek hain? Koi baat karna chahein toh bata sakte hain.
Customer: Mere saath meri sister baith/baithe hain abhi — woh help kar rahi hain. Dekhiye, main samjhta/samjhti hoon mera loan pending hai. Lekin abhi meri state aisi nahi hai ki main financial decisions le sakun.
Agent: Main bilkul samajh sakta/sakti hoon. Main aapka case vulnerable customer queue mein daalta/daalti hoon — koi pressure nahi hoga. Jab better feel karein tab reach out karein.
Customer: Shukriya. Yeh bahut zaruri tha.

Agent: Hello, main [Bank/Company Name] se baat kar raha hoon. Kya main Suresh Kumar ji se baat kar raha hoon?
Customer: Haan ji, main Suresh Kumar bol raha hoon. Kya baat hai?<interruption>
Agent: Suresh ji, aapka personal loan account number XXXX ka 15,000 rupay ka EMI 5 tarik ko due tha aur abhi tak pending dikha raha hai. Aap yeh payment kab tak clear kar denge?<interruption> Aapki suvidha ke liye humne reminder call kiya hai.
Customer: Haan, mujhe pata hai due hai, lekin main toh pareshan ho chuka hoon aap logon se. Jab dekho tab call kar rahe ho. Aur usse bhi zyada pareshani yeh hai ki aapne mera CIBIL score galat report kar diya hai!
Agent: CIBIL score sir? Kis vishay mein keh rahe hain aap?
Customer: Mere account mein dikha raha hai ki maine payment nahi kiya hai, aur mera score neeche ja raha hai. Maine aapko bataya bhi tha ki mujhe thodi der ho sakti hai, maine koi default nahi kiya hai. Ab main is account ki payment tab tak nahi karunga, jab tak aap yeh CIBIL mein galat entry theek nahi karoge. Pehle mera credit report sahi karvao, tab baat karenge payment ki.
Agent: Sir, CIBIL reporting toh hamare system se automatically jati hai. Agar koi discrepancy hai, toh hum use investigate kar sakte hain. Par is process mein thoda samay lagta hai. Jab tak investigation chalegi, tab tak EMI toh pending nahi reh sakti na, sir. Aap payment aaj kar dijiye, hum CIBIL team ko isko aage badhane ke liye bol dete hain.
Customer: Nahi, main bol raha hoon na. Yeh meri galti nahi hai. Meri taraf se sab theek hai. Aap logon ne galat report kiya hai. Agar CIBIL mein yeh default show hota rahega toh main loan chukane ke bawajood nuksan mein rahunga. Isliye, meri shart hai ki pehle aap yeh CIBIL report sahi karvao, uski correction request dalo aur confirm karo. Uske baad main payment karunga. Jab tak correction nahi hoti, tab tak main ek bhi paisa nahi bharunga.
Agent: Theek hai Suresh ji, main aapki baat samajh raha hoon. Hum is CIBIL matter ko ek grievance ke roop mein escalate kar dete hain aur jald se jald usko verify karwaate hain. Lekin aapko bhi kuch confirm karna hoga sir. Hum isse system mein log kar rahe hain ki aap CIBIL report mein sudhar ke baad hi payment karenge. Kya yahi aapka antim decision hai?
Customer: Haan, yahi mera decision hai. Aap yeh theek karvao aur mujhe update do. Uske baad hi payment. Aur future calls is CIBIL correction ke update ke liye honi chahiye, not for payment reminder.
Agent: Samjh gaya sir. Main aapki request aage badha deta hoon. Dhanyawad.

Agent: Namaste, kya maine Rajesh Kumar se baat kar sakta hoon? Yeh Axis Bank ke collection team se bol raha hoon regarding aapka overdue loan account.

Customer: Haan, haan... ek minute. <interruption> Haan, main yeh bol sakta hoon ki... wo asal mein... Rajesh abhi ghar mein nahi hai.

Agent: Theek hai, toh main aapko kaunsa relation hai? Aap Rajesh Kumar hain ya kisi aur ka naam hai?

Customer: Nahi nahi, main Rajesh ka beta hoon. Main Arjun bol raha hoon. Aap samajhiye, mere pita ko... wo almost teen mahine pehle ek stroke aaya tha. Abhi bilkul speech nahi aa rahi unhe, aur na hi wo samajh sakte hain kuch. Bed-ridden hain bilkul.

Agent: Oh, mujhe bahut dukh hue yeh sunnkar. Toh Rajesh Uncle abhi... wo communicate nahi kar sakte? Aur aapka maa, ya koi aur family member hai jo iska responsibility le sakta hai?

Customer: Nahi bhai, sirf main hoon ab. Meri mummy do saal pehle hi... wo chali gayin. Papa ke liye ab main hi sab kuch dekh raha hoon — medicines, nurses, sab. Aur ab aapke liye bhi paise... <interruption> Actually, humein pata hi nahi tha ki papa ka itna bada loan tha. Jab maine bank ke statement dekhe, tab pata chala.

Agent: Sir, calls toh hum reminders ke liye karte hain, but agar aap busy hain to kya main aapko baad mein call back karoon ya fir aap bata sakte hain ki payment kab tak karenge?
Customer: Maine bola na, I am not interested right now. Main free nahi hoon baat karne ke liye. Jo bhi details hain, please email kar do. Email toh aapke paas hai na? Bus, calls band kar do thode time ke liye. Bahut frequent ho rahe hain.

Agent: Okay sir. Main details email karwa deta hoon. Thank you.

Agent: Namaste, am I speaking to Rajesh Kumar?

Customer: Haan, yes, speaking. Who is this?

Agent: This is Priya from the collections team at FinServe Capital. I'm calling regarding your loan account ending in 4782. Your EMI of 15,200 rupees was due on the 15th of this month, and we haven't received payment yet. Can we discuss this?

Customer: Yes, yes, I know. Listen, I... I'm having some problems right now. It's not that I don't want to pay, but things have become very difficult.

Agent: I understand, Rajesh. Can you tell me what's happening? Are you facing any specific issue with payment?

Customer: Actually, my company... the company I was working at for the last eight years, they closed down. Just like that, two weeks ago. The factory shut down completely. They gave us one month's salary and then... finished. No notice, no warning. They said the business is not running anymore.

Agent: Oh, that's very difficult news. I'm sorry to hear that. So you've lost your job recently?

Customer: Yes, yaar. Completely lost. I was earning 65,000 per month, and now I have nothing coming in. My wife is a teacher, she makes about 28,000, but that's not enough for all the expenses, na. The rent is 12,000, there's school fees for my two kids, groceries, electricity... and then this EMI on top. I haven't paid since the 15th. I don't know what to do.

Agent: <interruption> I see, I see. And when did you lose your job exactly?

Customer: Two weeks back. On the... on the 2nd of this month. The owner just called everyone and said the company is closing. No one expected this. I've been looking for work, sending my resume to different places, but nothing has come through yet. It takes time, no?

Agent: Absolutely, it does. Rajesh, I can see you're in a difficult situation. Have you been able to find any alternative income or work in these two weeks?

Customer: No, no, nothing yet. I went to a few places, but there are no openings right now. One company said they might have something in three weeks, but I'm not sure. In the meantime, I have no salary, and my wife's income is very tight. We're managing from our savings, but that will finish in maybe two months if things continue like this.

Agent: I understand. So currently, you have no immediate income besides your wife's 28,000 rupees per month. Is that correct?

Customer: Yes, that's right. Her salary comes on the 25th of every month, but we use it for everything else. The EMI was supposed to come from my salary, you understand? Now there's nothing. I want to pay, Priya, I'm not refusing, but I genuinely don't have the money right now.

Agent: <interruption> I believe you, Rajesh. This is clearly a hardship situation. Let me ask you — when do you think you might have income again? Is there any timeline you're expecting?

Customer: That company I mentioned, they said maybe three weeks or a month. But I'm also sending applications to other places. If I get something quickly, maybe four to five weeks from now I could start earning again. But I cannot promise anything. I'm very worried, to be honest.

Agent: I can hear the concern in your voice. Let me see what options we have. Given that you've experienced sudden job loss and your household income has dropped significantly, this qualifies as genuine hardship. Before I can discuss any restructuring or relief options, I need to verify a few details with you. Can you confirm your current address? Is it still the same — 42-B, Sector 7, Ghaziabad?

Customer: Yes, yes, that's correct. But listen, I have to tell you something. I also have another loan — a personal loan of about 3 lakhs with another bank. Their EMI is 8,500, and it's due on the 20th. So when my wife's salary comes, I have to juggle between your EMI and theirs, and the house expenses. It's very difficult.

Agent: That adds to the pressure, no doubt. So you're managing multiple obligations with limited income. This is what we call overindebtedness. Rajesh, based on what you've told me, I want to escalate your account for a hardship assessment and potential restructuring. This means we may be able to reduce your EMI temporarily, or extend your loan tenure, so that you can manage better with your current income situation.

Customer: Really? Can you reduce the EMI? If you can make it 8,000 or 9,000, then maybe I can manage with my wife's salary until I find work. That would help me a lot.

Agent: That's a valid request, and it's exactly what I want to explore. However, I need to escalate this to our senior team for approval. They will review your employment situation, income documentation, and other factors. Can you provide me with any proof of your job loss? Like a termination letter or severance letter from your company?

Customer: I have a message from the owner on WhatsApp saying the company is closing. I can forward that to you. And I have my bank statements showing my salary deposits until August. After that, nothing. Will that work?

Agent: Yes, absolutely. That will help. Please send those documents to the email I'll provide. In the meantime, Rajesh, I want to be clear about where things stand. You currently cannot pay the full EMI of 15,200 because of sudden unemployment. You're looking for work and expect to have income within three to five weeks, possibly sooner. Is that a fair summary?

Customer: Yes, that's correct. I want to pay, I really do. I'm just asking for some relief until I get back on my feet.

Agent: I hear you. What I'm going to do is flag your account as a hardship case with employment disruption. Our senior collections manager will review your file within 24 hours and may call you to discuss restructuring options. In the meantime, I strongly advise you not to ignore this account. Keep in touch, and as soon as you have any income, please reach out to us immediately, okay?

Customer: Okay, okay. Thank you for understanding. I was worried you would just keep calling and demanding payment. This is... this is helpful. Should I send those documents now?

Agent: Yes, please send them at your earliest convenience. Also, Rajesh, can I get an alternate contact number in case this line is unavailable?

Customer: Yes, my wife's number is 98765-43210. You can reach me there as well. But please, try to call me first if possible.

Agent: Noted. I've made a note on your account. We'll be in touch within 24 hours with next steps. Thank you for being transparent about your situation, and I hope the restructuring process helps you get back on track.

Customer: Thank you so much. I appreciate this. I will send the documents right away.

Customer: Haan, haan, theek hai. Link bhej dijiye. Main kar deta hu abhi 10-15 minute mein.
Agent: Perfect, Rohan ji. Link main aapko abhi bhej raha hu. Thank you for your cooperation.

<noise>call waiting beep</noise>

<noise>office ambient noise</noise>

<noise>keyboard typing sounds</noise>

Customer: Look, I don't think I owe that much. When I took the loan, it was supposed to be 1,50,000 rupees. You people have added so much interest and charges. I don't agree with this amount at all.

Agent: I understand your concern, Rajesh. Let me explain — the interest accrues monthly based on your loan agreement. The amount shown includes the principal, accrued interest, and a late fee because the payment is now 13 days overdue. I can send you a detailed statement if you'd like to verify.

Customer: No, no, no. I don't want any statement. I'm telling you, this whole thing is wrong. I'm not paying this. You people are cheating me with all these extra charges.

Agent: Rajesh, I hear your frustration. But the charges are as per the agreement you signed. Can we work out a payment plan? Even if you can pay half now — say Rs 90,000 — we can structure the remainder—

Customer: I'm not paying anything. Not now, not later. I don't believe in this debt. It's all inflated. Why should I pay for something that's been calculated wrongly?

Agent: Sir, I understand you feel the amount is incorrect, but our records are clear. You've been making payments regularly until August. What changed? Is there a financial difficulty you're facing?

Agent: Rajesh, I appreciate your position, but we do need to resolve this. If we don't hear from you, this account will move to legal recovery. Is there any way we can—

Customer: Do whatever you want. File a case, go to court, I don't care. But I'm not paying. This is harassment. Stop calling me. I'm hanging up now.

Agent: Sir, please don't—

Customer: <interruption> No more calls. Understood?

Customer: Exactly. Exactly yahi baat hai. Main default nahi karna chahta. Mere pass paisa hai, salary aata hai 20th ko, lekin account block hai toh kya kar sakta hoon?

Agent: Sir, bilkul samajh gaya. Toh hum ek approach try karte hain. Kya aap NEFT se payment kar sakte ho? Ya phir branch mein jakar cash deposit kar sakte ho?

Customer: NEFT? Lekin NEFT bhi toh bank account se hi jaata hai na? Account block hai toh...

Agent: <interruption> Haan sir, aap bilkul sahi kah rahe ho. Agar account block hai toh NEFT bhi nahi hoga. Aur branch mein cash deposit, woh bhi account ke name mein hi hona padta hai.

Customer: Haan, toh bilkul stuck hoon main. Lekin main 21st ko as soon as hold hatega, immediately transfer kar dunga. Aap mere liye note kar do na?

Agent: Bilkul sir, main note kar dunga. Toh aapka commitment hai 21st June ko payment karna 2,47,000 rupees ka, jaise hi aapka bank hold hatega, theek hai?

Customer: Haan bilkul. 21st tak. Lekin agar 20th ko hi account open ho jaye toh main 20th ko hi kar dunga. Pehle se kar dunga.

Agent: Bilkul sir, samajh gaya. Main ek note kar raha hoon — account hold pending bank KYC verification, expected resolution within 5-7 days from now. As soon as hold is lifted, borrower committed to payment on 21st June. Sir, aapka bank account hold kab se start hua tha?

Customer: Arre, 6th June ko tha. Toh 11th ya 12th tak hopefully clear ho jayega.

Agent: Bilkul sir. Aur agar koi update aaye bank se, toh aap mujhe call kar sakte ho? Ya main aapko callback de du 19th ko reminder ke liye?

Customer: Haan, 19th ko call kar do. Reminder de dena. Aur agar early clear ho jaye toh main khud call kar dunga.

Agent: Perfect sir, bilkul. Main 19th ko callback schedule kar dunga. Aur sir, ek baat aur — agar bank account clear nahi hua toh aap alternative payment method dhundne mein mujhe batana, theek hai? Hum kuch aur option explore kar sakte hain.

Customer: Theek hai, theek hai. Main cooperate karunga. Aur sorry yaar, iska mera koi fault nahi tha. Bank ne hi block kar diya.

Agent: Bilkul sir, samajh gaya. Aapko koi tension nahi hona. Aap willing ho payment karne ke liye, toh hum sab kuch manage kar lenge. Main aapka file ko mark kar dunga — "Account operationally blocked, borrower cooperative, follow-up scheduled 19th June." Theek hai?

Customer: Haan, bilkul. Shukriya aapka.

Agent: Aapka swagat hai sir. Take care, aur 21st tak zaroor call kar dijiye jab payment kar dijiye. Bye sir.

Customer: Bye, shukriya.

Agent: Okay Rajesh ji. Main link send kar raha hoon aur aapka payment aaj ke liye process karwa deta hoon. Call disconnect karne se pehle, koi aur help kar sakta hoon aapki?

Hum yeh samajhna chahenge taaki hum aapki behtar madad kar saken.Customer: Particular reason toh yahi hai ki mera already ek car loan chal raha hai aur ghar ka bhi kuch udhar hai jo settle karna pad raha hai. Ek toh pehle se itni EMI hai, aur upar se is mahine thoda unforeseen expense bhi aa gaya. Toh, frankly speaking, teen-teen EMIs ek saath manage karna is samay bohot mushkil ho raha hai.Agent: Aapka kehna hai ki aapki kayi saari EMIs ek saath chal rahi hain, Prakash ji, aur is wajah se aapko ek sath payment manage karne mein mushkil ho rahi hai. Kya aap humein approximate bata sakte hain ki aapka monthly income kitna hai aur total EMIs kitni hain, agar aap comfortable hon toh?Customer: Dekhiye, Rajesh ji, salary toh meri utni hi hai, pichle saal se badhi nahi hai. Aur total EMI around 70-75% of my salary jaa rahi hai. Abhi toh main bas koshish kar raha hoon ki kahan se thoda adjust kar loon. Dusre bank ka personal loan bhi pending hai. Main yahi soch raha hoon ki abhi toh lagta hai Bank-Y ki EMI bharni padegi pehle.Agent: Toh Prakash ji, aapki income mein stability hai, lekin multiple loan commitments ke karan aapko funds adjust karne mein issue aa raha hai aur aap ek priority choose kar rahe hain. Mai samajh gaya. Kya aap humein yeh bata sakte hain ki aap is loan ki EMI ka payment kab tak expect kar sakte hain? Agar aapko thodi respite chahiye toh hum EMI re-schedule karne ya koi chhota amount abhi pay karke baaki baad mein manage karne ka option explore kar sakte hain. Aapki kya ray hai?Customer: Respite mil jaye toh bohot accha hoga Rajesh ji. Agar thoda time mil jaye, ya koi structure change ho sake toh main dekhunga. Kyunki filhaal ek sath sara adjust karna impossible lag raha hai. Ek hafta aur mil jaye toh main thoda funds manage kar lunga.Agent: Theek hai Prakash ji. Hum aapki baat samajh gaye hain ki aap overindebtedness ki wajah se abhi payment nahi kar pa rahe hain aur thoda time ya restructuring options dekh rahe hain. Hum definitely aapke liye best possible solution discuss karte hain. Main aapko apne senior se consult karke wapas call karta hoon ek se do working days mein. Kya aapko yeh theek lagega?Customer: Ji, haan, bilkul theek rahega. Shukriya Rajesh ji.Agent: Dhanyawaad Prakash ji, aapka din shubh ho.

transcript: Agent: Namaste, mera naam Anita hai. Kya meri baat Ramesh Kumar ji se ho rahi hai? Ye call aapke loan account number 7890123456 ke sambandh mein hai. Apne baare mein thoda confirm karenge aap?Jaise aapka janm tithi ya phir pita ka naam. Customer: Haan, main Ramesh Kumar bol raha hoon. Janm tithi hai 15 August 1980. Ji, kaisa sambandh? Koi zaroorat nahi. Aap bataiye kya baat hai? Mujhe ek notice mila hai. Agent: Ji dhanyawad, aapki identity confirm ho gayi hai. Haan Ramesh ji, aapko hamare taraf se ek legal notice mila hoga, usi ke sandarbh mein baat karne ke liye maine call kiya hai. Aapka account abhi tak NPA mein hai aur EMI baki hai. Customer: Haan mila hai notice. Aur main bahut pareshaan hoon Anita ji. Maine aap logo ko kai baar phone kiya tha ki meri naukri chali gayi hai aur main payment nahi kar pa raha. Ab aap logon ne seedha kanooni notice bhej diya. Main abhi court ka kya karoon, kya yeh sab sach hai? Agent: Ramesh ji, hum samajh sakte hain aapki pareshani. Aapka case ab humari legal team ko transfer ho chuka hai kyunki kafi samay se payments pending hain. Legal notice sahi hai aur aapko uspar response dena hoga. Is notice ka matlab hai ki bank ab aage kanooni kaarwai kar sakta hai. Customer: To ab mere paas kya option hai? Kya main court mein ja kar kuch baat kar sakta hoon? Ya phir isse bachne ka koi aur tarika hai? Main abhi bhi puri amount nahi de paunga, lekin main thoda-thoda kar ke dene ke liye taiyar hoon. Agent: Ramesh ji, court jaana toh aapka adhikar hai, par main aapko salah doongi ki aap humari legal department se sampark karein. Unke paas settlement options bhi hote hain. Agar aap abhi bhi kuch payment kar ke settlement karna chahte hain, toh hum yeh baat legal team tak pahuncha sakte hain, ya aap seedhe unse baat kar sakte hain. Customer: Toh unka number kya hai? Kya mujhe court jane ki zaroorat nahi padegi agar settlement ho jata hai toh? Kyunki ab main yeh sab case-wake mein nahi padna chahta. Aapko pata hai ki naukri ke baad bhi kitni mushkil hoti hai, ab court ka chakkar kahan se lagau. Agent: Ji, agar aap settlement par agree ho jaate hain aur sharten poori karte hain, toh legal action ko roka ja sakta hai. Main aapko legal department ka number aur email ID bhej rahi hoon abhi SMS par. Aap please jaldi unse contact kijiye aur apni situation explain kijiye. Unko bataiye ki aap settlement chahte hain. Customer: Theek hai Anita ji, main aaj hi unko call karta hoon. Shukriya aapki madad ke liye. Agent: Bilkul Ramesh ji, aur kripya karke is mamle ko seriously lein aur turant respond karein. Legal team se baat karne ke baad, koi bhi jaankari mujhe ya hamari general customer care ko dene ki bajaye, unke saath hi directly communicate karein. Dhanyawad.

Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Rajesh Kumar?

Customer: Yes, this is Rajesh. But I am very busy right now. What is this call regarding?

Agent: Namaste, Mr. Kumar. My name is Priya from ICICI Fintech Collections. I am calling regarding your personal loan account ending in 4827. Your EMI payment of rupees 8,500 was due on the 15th of this month, and we have not yet received it. Can we discuss your payment status?

Customer: Haan, I know about the EMI. Look, I have been meaning to call you actually. The thing is, I have submitted all my documents to my HR department for a salary revision letter. I got promoted three months back, and the bank asked me to provide an updated income certificate before I can... before I can make any large payment commitment.

Agent: I see. That sounds like positive news regarding your promotion, Mr. Kumar. So you are waiting for this income certificate from your employer?

Customer: Yes, exactly. My HR is very slow, yaar. They said they will issue the letter by next Thursday, 22nd of this month. Once I have that, I can approach my bank and sort out my account situation. Right now, I don't want to make a promise I cannot keep because of some documentation issue.

Agent: That makes complete sense. Can I ask — do you have any idea about the timeframe after you receive the letter? Will you be able to submit it to us immediately, or is there any further processing needed?

Customer: (<interruption>) Once I get the letter, I will... I will forward it to you the same day via email. Then your team can verify it and... and we can sit down and plan the repayment properly. Maybe a restructuring, maybe increased EMI, I don't know yet. But I need that letter first.

Agent: Understood, Mr. Kumar. So the income certificate is critical before you can commit to any repayment plan or restructure. And you are expecting it by the 22nd?

Customer: Yes, 22nd. That is what HR told me. But sometimes they are late, so I am a bit worried. If it gets delayed, I will call you immediately. I promise I will not disappear.

Agent: Thank you for that assurance. I will make a note that we are awaiting your updated income certificate from your employer, expected by the 22nd of this month. Once you receive it, please email it to our collections team at the email address I am about to share, or you can call me directly. Can I share that email?

Customer: Yes, go ahead.

Agent: The email is collections-follow-up@icicifintech.com. Please use the subject line "Loan Account 4827 - Income Certificate" so we can track it properly. Is there anything else blocking your payment right now, or is it purely the documentation?

Customer: No, the documentation is the main thing. Once I have that letter, I have the funds to pay. The promotion has increased my salary, so I am in a better position than before. I just need to prove it to the bank.

Agent: That is excellent news, and I am very glad to hear your financial situation has improved. I will schedule a follow-up call for the 23rd of this month to check on the status of the income certificate. Does that work for you?

Customer: Yes, 23rd is fine. Call me after 6 PM if possible, because I am in office meetings most of the day.

Agent: Perfect. I have noted that down — follow-up call on the 23rd after 6 PM. Mr. Kumar, just to confirm: once you provide the income certificate, we will need a few days to verify it internally. But you understand that your account is currently overdue by one EMI, so as soon as we receive and verify the certificate, we would like you to make a payment or enter into a formal restructure agreement. Is that clear?

Customer: Yes, I understand. I will not delay once I have the documents. This is my first time defaulting, and I want to get this sorted quickly.

Agent: I appreciate your cooperation, Mr. Kumar. Your account reflects that this is indeed the first missed payment, and we value your proactive communication. We will be in touch on the 23rd. Thank you for your time.

Customer: Thank you. Goodbye.

Agent: Goodbye, Mr. Kumar. Have a good day.

Main abhi aapke account par ek special note add kar raha hoon aur ise apni senior team ko escalate kar raha hoon. Woh aapse ek-do din mein contact karenge, jab aap behtar feel karein aur jab Rajat ji bhi maujood hon. Aap please tab tak koi chinta na karein. Customer: Theek hai, theek hai beta. Aapko jo sahi lage, wahi kar do. Mujhse toh kuch nahi ho paa raha ab. Dhanyawaad.

Agent: Hello, good afternoon. May I speak to Mr. Ranjit Kumar, please? This is Aryan from SwiftFin India regarding your personal loan account.
Customer: Yeah, hello, speaking. Who is this again? You said SwiftFin?
Agent: Yes, SwiftFin India, sir. We are calling regarding your personal loan, account number ending in 3045. Your EMI of INR 78,500 was due on the 5th of last month and is currently 35 days overdue. Can you please confirm your date of birth for verification, sir?
Customer: My date of birth? What date of birth do you want? I don't recall taking any loan with you people, actually.
Agent: Sir, your name as per our records is Ranjit Kumar, and the account is active. To proceed, I need to verify your identity. Can you please state your date of birth or your mother's maiden name, sir?
Customer: Hmm, actually I am, uh... I am Ranjit only. But I think this must be a mistake. My DOB is, uh... give me a moment. It is uh... what is it now? Oh, come on, I am always forgetting this number. What are the digits, can you give me some clue? No loan from my side. Definitely.
Agent: Sir, I cannot disclose any details before verification for security reasons. The date of birth on file is 12th February 1988. Does that sound correct, sir? We have very clear records of this loan disbursed to Ranjit Kumar.
Customer: No, no, no! My DOB is not that. That is some other person. This is not my loan account only. Please don't call this number again for this. Maybe some other Ranjit. Wrong number, I think.
Agent: Sir, I understand. However, the contact number you are speaking from is registered with this loan account. Given the inconsistencies in identity verification, I am unable to proceed with this conversation. We will have to flag this account internally. Thank you for your time, sir. Goodbye.
Customer: What flag? I said it's wrong num...
Customer: The person you are trying to reach is not answering. Please try again later.

Agent: Hello, is this Rajesh Kumar?

Customer: Haan, speaking. Who is this?

Agent: Hi Rajesh, this is Priya from Fintech Collections. I'm calling about your loan account, the one ending in 4521. You're currently 45 days overdue on your EMI, na. Outstanding balance is 47,300 rupees.

Customer: Look, I don't want to talk about this. You people have called me four times this week already. Four times! It's too much, yaar. I told the last agent very clearly — do not call me anymore. I'm serious about this.

Agent: I understand, Rajesh. But we do need to work this out. The amount is significantly overdue now. Can we discuss a payment plan? Maybe after your salary comes in next week, you could—

Customer: No, no, no. You're not listening. I have already sent a formal letter to your compliance department. I have also filed a complaint with the RBI about the excessive calling. This is harassment and it's a violation of my rights. I'm telling you now — stop calling me. Do not contact me anymore.

Agent: Rajesh, I hear you. Let me note this down immediately. You're requesting that we stop all contact with your account, correct? I'm going to flag this right now as a Do Not Contact request and escalate it to our compliance and legal teams immediately. No further outreach will happen pending their review.

Customer: Yes. Yes, that's what I'm saying. And I want this documented. I have instructed my lawyer to send you a cease and desist notice if there's any more contact. I will not be making any payment until this is resolved properly. You need to stop calling me now.

Agent: Understood completely, Rajesh. I'm logging your verbal Do Not Contact request into the system right now. Your account is being flagged for immediate escalation to our legal and compliance teams. All outreach will cease pending their review. You will not receive any further calls from our collections team. If there are any legal proceedings, you will be contacted only by our legal department. Is there anything else I should note?

Customer: Just make sure this is documented properly. I've filed an RBI complaint, I've sent a formal letter, and my lawyer is preparing a cease and desist notice. I don't want any more calls.

Agent: Completely noted, Rajesh. Your account is now marked as Do Not Contact. All of this — the RBI complaint, the formal letter, the legal representation — I'm documenting everything. You will not be contacted by our collections team. Thank you for your time, and I apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

Customer: Thank you. Goodbye.

Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Rajesh Kumar?

Customer: Haan, haan, this is Rajesh speaking. Who is calling, yaar? Another collection call, na?

Agent: Hi Rajesh, this is Priya from Fintech Collections. I'm calling regarding your loan account FL-2847-5693. Do you have a few minutes?

Customer: Haan, okay, but jaldi batao. I've been getting calls from you people for the past two weeks. What is this about?

Agent: I understand, Rajesh. Your account shows an outstanding balance of Rs. 1,47,500 as of today. Your last payment was made on the 15th of last month. Can we discuss a payment plan?

Customer: Wait, wait, wait. One minute, yaar. The amount you're saying — 1,47,500 — that's not correct, na. I checked my statement last week. The balance should be around 1,20,000 only. Why is there such a big difference? This doesn't make sense.

Agent: Let me pull up your account details. <pause> The outstanding amount includes your principal balance, plus accrued interest, and a late payment penalty applied after your account went 45 days overdue.

Customer: But that's exactly what I'm saying, na. The interest and penalty — I don't think those should be charged. I was only 10 days late, not 45 days. And the penalty amount seems very high. How was this calculated? This is wrong.

Agent: So you're disputing the interest and penalty charges that have been applied?

Customer: Yes, exactly. And not just that — I checked my CIBIL report last week, and it's showing this account as 90 days overdue. But I made a payment on the 15th of last month, na. So how can it be 90 days overdue? The bureau information is completely wrong. This is affecting my business, yaar. I need to get a loan for my expansion, and now my credit score is damaged because of wrong information.

Agent: <pause> I understand your concern, Rajesh. The CIBIL report is updated based on the account status at the time of reporting. If your account was overdue when the report was generated, it would show that status.

Customer: No, no, you're not listening to me. I made a payment. The payment was successful. I have the UPI reference number. So the bureau should show my account as current, not 90 days overdue. This is incorrect reporting. How can I make another payment when my credit score is already damaged because of wrong information? This is not fair, na.

Agent: I understand your frustration, Rajesh. Let me check the payment records. <pause> I see a payment of Rs. 50,000 was received on the 15th of last month. Is that the payment you're referring to?

Customer: Yes, that's the one. So if that payment was received, why is the bureau still showing me as 90 days overdue? That doesn't make sense. The bureau reporting is inaccurate, and I want this corrected before I make any further payments. I'm not paying anything until this is sorted out.

Agent: Rajesh, I appreciate you bringing this up. The bureau reporting is based on the account status at the time of the monthly report submission. Even though you made a payment, if your account was overdue before that payment, the bureau would have already received the overdue status. The next update would reflect your current status.

Customer: So when will that update happen? And how do I know it will be corrected? I'm not going to pay more money until I see that my bureau report is fixed. This is affecting my ability to get credit for my business expansion. I need this resolved first, yaar.

Agent: I understand, Rajesh. What I can do is escalate this to our bureau reporting team. They will verify the accuracy of the information reported to CIBIL and, if there's an error, they will file a correction request with the bureau. This process typically takes 30 to 45 days.

Customer: 30 to 45 days? That's too long, na. And I'm not making any payment until this is sorted. You people reported wrong information about me to the bureau, and now I'm the one suffering. I want a written confirmation that you will correct this, and I want to know the exact timeline.

Agent: I will definitely escalate this, Rajesh. Let me take down your email address so I can send you the escalation details and keep you updated on the bureau correction process.

Customer: My email is rajesh.kumar.1987@gmail.com. But I'm serious — I'm not paying anything until I see proof that the bureau correction has been initiated. And I want this in writing from your manager or supervisor.

Agent: Noted, Rajesh. I'm logging this as a bureau reporting dispute on your account. I will escalate this to my supervisor and our bureau team today itself. You should expect a call or email from them within 24 hours with the next steps. Is there anything else I can help clarify about your account?

Customer: Just make sure this gets resolved. I've been a customer for three years, and I've never defaulted before this. One late payment, and suddenly I'm marked as 90 days overdue on the bureau. It's not fair, yaar. This is damaging my reputation and my business prospects.

Agent: I completely understand, Rajesh. I'm noting all of this down. Your concern about the bureau reporting accuracy is valid, and we will investigate this. You'll hear from us soon.

Customer: Okay. Thank you.

Customer: Haan ji, main Rajesh bol raha hu. Kahiye.

Jab maine system pe check kiya tha ya jo pehle message aaye the, usmein thoda kam tha. Pata nahi ye Rs. 15,500 kaisa aa raha hai. Kya aapko lagta hai ki koi extra charges lag gaye hain?
Agent: Jee Rajesh ji, aapki baat samajh raha hu. Lekin mere system mein to Rs. 15,500 hi dikha raha hai, jismein aapki principal amount, interest aur jo bhi applicable charges hain, woh shamil hain. Aapko kis amount ka andaaza tha ya kitne ka message mila tha?
Customer: Mujhe laga tha yeh kareeb 14,000 ya usse bhi thoda kam hoga. Yeh 15,500, pata nahi kaise aa gaya. Maine har baar time pe pay kiya hai, toh extra charge lagne ka reason bhi nahi hona chahiye. Ya toh koi calculation mein mistake hai, ya interest zyada laga diya hai. Main is amount pe payment nahi karunga jab tak yeh clear na ho.
Agent: Theek hai Rajesh ji. Aap chinta mat kijiye, hum yeh check kar lete hain. Mai aapko abhi aapke registered email ID par loan statement bhej deta hu. Ek baar aap check kar lenge toh fir baat karenge.
Customer: Haan theek hai, statement bhej dijiye. Mail par check karke fir baat karta hu. Jab tak clear nahi hota, main payment nahi karunga.

Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Rajesh Sharma? My name is Pooja from Bharat Loans, calling regarding your outstanding EMI for account number BL12345.Customer: Yes, this is Rajesh Sharma. Pooja ji, good afternoon. I... I know why you are calling. The EMI for my business loan is due.Agent: Good afternoon, Mr. Sharma. That's correct, the EMI of INR 15,500 was due on the 10th of this month. We noticed the payment hasn't been received yet. Could you please let us know when we can expect the payment?Customer: Pooja ji, that's what I was trying to figure out how to tell you. This past month... it's been really terrible for me. My small electronics shop, it was completely flooded during the recent heavy rains last week. You know how those flash floods happened?Agent: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, Mr. Sharma. The news did report extensive damage in your area. Please continue.Customer: Everything, all my stock, almost seventy percent of it is just gone, damaged beyond repair. My shop has been closed for a week already. I have no income, Pooja ji, nothing coming in. How will I pay this EMI right now? I don't know how to restart. It's been a complete disaster. We have specific provisions for customers who are facing hardships due to natural disasters. Would you be open to discussing options with us?Customer: Options? What options? I just need some time. I need to get my shop working again first.Agent: Yes, Mr. Sharma. What we can do is initiate a hardship assessment process for your account. You might be eligible for some temporary relief or a restructuring based on your situation. We would require you to submit some supporting documents, like photographs of the damage, perhaps a local authority report if you have one, and any other evidence of the financial loss your business incurred due to the floods.Customer: Documents? Like photos of my damaged shop? I have some photos on my phone.Agent: Yes, exactly. If you can email those to us, along with a brief letter explaining the situation, we can review your case. I can send you an SMS right now with the email address and a list of required documents. We will then escalate your request for assessment. Meanwhile, please understand this process takes a few days. We will pause any aggressive collection calls from our side once your documents are received.Customer: Okay... Okay, that sounds like... a little bit of relief to know there are options. Please send me the details, Pooja ji. I will try my best to send whatever I have.Agent: Understood, Mr. Sharma. I'm sending you the SMS now. Our team will review your application once we receive the documents. We will be in touch with you regarding the next steps. Please take care.Customer: Thank you, Pooja ji. Thank you for listening.Agent: You're welcome, Mr. Sharma. Have a good day.Customer: You too. Bye.

Agent: Hello, mera naam Pooja hai, main X Finance se baat kar rahi hoon. Kya meri baat Rajesh Kumar ji se ho rahi hai?Apka personal loan account number 1234567890 par ek EMI due hai, 15,000 rupay ki. Agent: Sir, please listen...<interruption>Customer: Nahi sunna. Dobara phone mat karna!

Agent: Good afternoon, may I speak with Mr. Sanjay Kumar, regarding his personal loan account ending in 7890? My name is Amit from ABC Finance.Customer: (Sighs heavily, agitated) Ah, Amit, phir se? Yaar, please. Haan, Sanjay Kumar bol raha hoon. But, seriously, this is... I mean, what time is it? Raat ke nau baj rahe hain! Aur aaj ka yeh paanchva call hai, I mean, five calls in one single day? However, I need to remind you about your pending EMI...Customer: Pending EMI? Aapko EMI se pehle yeh problem samajh nahi aa rahi? <interruption> You people, what are you doing? We take this feedback very seriously. And about the payment...Customer: Payment? Agar, Amit, suno, agar mujhe ab ek bhi call raat ke saat baje ke baad aaya, ya phir mere kisi aur family member ko call gaya... This will be escalated to our compliance department immediately. For now, I will also mark your account for no further outbound calls from our end for the next 48 hours to allow for this investigation.Customer: Forty-eight hours is fine, but I want a permanent solution. Aur ab aapki company se nahi, mere lawyer aapse baat karenge. Theek hai? Good bye.

Agent: <interruption> Sir, yeh to bahut serious issue hai. Aapka address aur dusre aadmi ka address same hai?

Customer: Haan sir, same building, lekin different flat. Lekin sir, mujhe lagta hai yeh sab coordinated hai. Mere account par kya ho raha hai?

Agent: Sir, main aapko ek minute hold par rakhta hoon. Mujhe apne supervisor ko inform karna padega.

Customer: Haan, theek hai. Lekin sir, jaldi karo. Mujhe lagta hai mere identity ka misuse ho raha hai.

Agent: Sir, main aapko samajh gaya. Yeh bahut serious issue hai. Main aapke account ko immediately fraud team ko escalate kar dunga. Aapko koi aur call nahi aayega abhi tak jab tak fraud team investigate nahi kar le.

Customer: Theek hai sir. Lekin mera payment ka kya hoga?

Agent: Sir, aapka payment hold rahega jab tak investigation complete nahi ho jata. Aapko fraud team se contact aayega. Aapka account suppress kar diya jayega.

Customer: Theek hai sir. Dhanyavaad.

Customer: Reason yeh hai ki main pehle bhi baar baar commitment deta/deti raha/rahi hoon aur kuch nahi hua. Aur honestly abhi situation aisi hai ki nahi ho sakta. Legal action leni hai toh lo — main prepare hoon.

Customer: Nahi, yeh sab abhi thik nahi hai. Mujhe apne senior manager se baat karni hai. Aur haan, mere paas ek aur loan hai ICICI se. Usme EMI 12,000 rupees hai aur woh bhi due hai. Toh pehle tum pichle settlement ko clear karo, phir main soch lunga ki naya settlement kaise hoga.
