Kya pata aapke system mein kyun nahi dikh raha hai.Agent: Koi baat nahi Rakesh ji, hum isse verify karwa lete hain. Aapne jo reference ID diya hai, humari internal team isse check karegi. Agar payment received ho chuki hai toh aapke account se due status hata diya jayega.Customer: Theek hai, jaldi se check karwa dena. Aise baar baar calls mat karwana agar payment ho gayi hai toh.Agent: Definitely Rakesh ji. Hum isse check karwa kar aapko ek confirmation SMS bhej denge 24-48 ghante mein. Tab tak aapko further calls nahi aayengi. Aur agar by chance koi issue hota hai, toh hum aapse contact karenge, theek hai?Customer: Theek hai. Thanks.

Agent: Good afternoon, sir. Am I speaking with Mr. Anand Kumar?Agent: This call is from Capital Credit, regarding your personal loan account number PC123456. Your EMI of 3,500 rupees was due on the 5th of July, and the outstanding balance, including overdue charges, is currently 85,450 rupees. We haven't received payment yet, sir.Customer: Yes, yes, this is Anand only. Oh, good afternoon. Yes, I know about the loan. Actually, for me, things have been very tight. My shop had some unexpected repairs, no. So, it was a difficult time. I wish I could pay, truly, but right now, for me, paying full amount of 85,000, it is not possible, sir. I have been meaning to call you all.Agent: I understand your situation, Mr. Kumar. We appreciate you reaching out to us. To help you close this account, considering your difficulties, we can offer you a one-time settlement. Would you be open to hearing a settlement amount to clear your dues completely?Customer: A settlement? Okay, tell me, what is the offer?Agent: Based on your account status, we can offer you a full and final settlement amount of 65,000 rupees. If you pay this lump sum within the next 15 days, we will close your loan account and issue a No Objection Certificate. This will also clear your records.Customer: Sixty-five thousand? Mmm. Agent, for me, that is also a bit high, no. My financial condition, it is really very critical. Can you consider making it a round figure, say, 55,000 rupees? That would be much more manageable for me right now.Agent: Let me check with my supervisor for a moment, Mr. Kumar. Please hold the line. <interruption> Thank you for waiting, Mr. Kumar. We value your commitment to clear this. We can reduce the settlement offer to 60,000 rupees, considering your situation. This is the absolute best we can do to close your account amicably. You would need to pay this within 10 working days.Customer: Hmm. Sixty thousand. It's still a stretch, yes, but it is better. Okay, I agree to this. For me, I can arrange the 60,000 rupees. So, what is the next step now, no?Agent: Excellent, Mr. Kumar. We're glad we could find a solution. We will send you a formal settlement offer letter to your registered email address right away. This letter will confirm the settlement amount of 60,000 rupees and the payment deadline. You can make the payment using the link provided in that email or by visiting our branch. Once the payment is received, your account will be marked as settled, and the NOC will be issued within 7-10 working days. Do you have any questions about this?Customer: No, that sounds clear. So, I will receive the email, and then I will arrange money. Within 10 working days, I will pay. This is a big relief, sir. Thank you.Agent: You are most welcome, sir. We look forward to receiving your payment and helping you close your loan. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Kumar?Customer: No, thank you, sir.Agent: Thank you for your time, Mr. Kumar. Have a good day. Goodbye.Customer: Bye.

dialect: North Indian English with Hindi code-switching
transcript:
Agent: Hello, is this Rajesh Kumar?

Customer: Haan, yes, speaking. Who is this?

Agent: Hi Rajesh, this is Priya calling from Finserve Collections. I'm reaching out about your personal loan account with us — the one ending in 4782. Do you have a few minutes?

Customer: Uh, yeah, okay, but I'm... I'm actually at the hospital right now, so... what is it about?

Agent: Right, I understand. I'm calling because your account shows an outstanding balance of one lakh eighty-seven thousand five hundred rupees. The EMI was due on the 15th, and we haven't received any payment yet. Can you tell me what's happening with the account?

Customer: <interruption> Look, I know, I know the payment is due. But my father, he... he had a heart attack last week and he's still in the ICU. We've been spending everything on his treatment — the hospital bills are already crossing four lakhs and... <voice breaking> I don't even know if we have enough left for next month's expenses.

Agent: <pause> Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that, Rajesh. That sounds like an incredibly difficult situation. Is your father still receiving treatment?

Customer: Yes, yes, he's still in ICU. The doctors say he needs at least two, maybe three more weeks of intensive care. My mother is completely stressed, and I've taken leave from my job to be here with him. I have my car EMI, my home loan EMI, everything is pending right now because all the money is going to the hospital.

Agent: I hear you. Medical emergencies like this can drain your savings very quickly. <pause> So right now, between your father's treatment and your other loan obligations, you're stretched quite thin. When do you think the hospital situation might stabilize? Do the doctors have any timeline?

Customer: Maybe... maybe two or three weeks if he recovers well. After that, if he comes home, then maybe I can start paying something. But right now, I cannot promise anything. Everything is very uncertain, you know? The treatment is so expensive and... <pause> I'm just very stressed.

Agent: I completely understand, Rajesh. You're going through a lot, and I want to help you find a way forward. What I'm going to do is mark your account as a medical hardship case. This means we won't take any aggressive action for the next three weeks while your father recovers. <pause> After that, we can reconnect and see where things stand. Does that sound fair?

Customer: Yes, yes, that sounds... that sounds good. Thank you for understanding. I really appreciate it. Can you just... can you not call for a few days? I need to focus on the hospital situation right now.

Agent: Absolutely, Rajesh. I'm going to note that we'll hold off on contact for the next two weeks. We'll reach out again on the 28th of this month to check in. Is that okay?

Customer: Yes, that's fine. Thank you. I hope you understand this is not because I don't want to pay. It's just... it's a very difficult time right now.

Agent: I completely understand. You're not alone in this. Take care of your father and your family, and we'll work with you once things improve. Take care, Rajesh.

Customer: Thank you. Goodbye.

Agent: Hello Ajay Bhatt, this is Kavitha from LoanCo. I wanted to discuss your gold loan account.
Customer: Go ahead.
Agent: We are offering a settlement of 7,250 rupees — 50% of the outstanding — as a one-time closure.
Customer: That is still too high. My lawyer has reviewed the account and we believe the interest charges are not as per the agreement. We are willing to pay only the principal — which is roughly 5,075.
Agent: Ajay Bhatt, principal-only settlement is not something we can approve.
Customer: Then we have nothing to discuss. My lawyer will be sending a legal notice regarding the overcharged interest. I suggest you review the file before proceeding.
Agent: Noted. I will flag this for our legal team's review.
Customer: Please do. All further communication in writing only.

Agent: Namaste! Main XYZ Bank se Vikas baat kar raha hoon. Kya meri baat Rajesh Kumar ji se ho rahi hai?
Customer: Rajesh Kumar? Kon Rajesh Kumar? Aapne galat number lagaya hai, bhai sahab.
Agent: Maaf kijiyega, hamare records ke mutabik yeh 9xxxxxxxx7 number Rajesh Kumar ji ka registered hai, unke personal loan account number L-12345678 ke liye. Unki 15 tareekh ko EMI due ho gayi hai, aur hum usi ke baare mein baat karne ke liye call kar rahe the.
Customer: Dekho, Vikas ji, mera naam Rajesh Kumar nahi hai. Mera naam Anuj Sharma hai, aur yeh number main pichhle 8 saalon se use kar raha hoon. Maine kabhi koi loan liya hi nahi hai, na toh is bank se aur na hi kisi aur se. Aur is Rajesh Kumar ko toh main jaanta bhi nahi hoon. Aap kya baat kar rahe hain?
Agent: Anuj ji, aap keh rahe hain ki aap Anuj Sharma hain, aur yeh number aapka hai, lekin loan account Rajesh Kumar ke naam par hai aur isi number se linked hai? Kya aap thodi aur detail confirm kar sakte hain, jaise aapka pura naam, ya date of birth, jisse main apne system mein cross-verify kar sakoon?
Customer: Dekhiye, mai aapko apni personal details aise phone par kyun doon? Maine aapko bata diya ki yeh number mera hai, aur maine koi loan nahi liya. Yeh toh seedha-seedha identity theft ya fraud ka mamla lag raha hai. Kisi ne galat information deke loan le liya hai, aur mera number de diya. Aap please isko investigate kijiye. Mai yeh loan nahi bhugatunga kyunki yeh mera nahi hai.
Agent: Theek hai, Anuj ji, mai aapki baat samajh gaya. Aap jo keh rahe hain, hamare records ke hisaab se woh match nahi ho raha hai, aur yeh ek serious discrepancy hai. Main is account par abhi 'Fraud Flag' mark kar raha hoon aur ise apni fraud investigation team ko forward karunga. Unhe aap se kuch aur jankari ki zaroorat pad sakti hai. Aapka humein yeh inform karna bahut zaroori tha. Hum is mamle ki janch karenge.

Agent: Good morning, my name is Priya from ABC Finance, I am calling regarding your outstanding personal loan account, PL012345, with a due amount of 35,000 rupees. How may I help you resolve this today, Mr. Gupta? Customer: Priya, please, good morning. This is Rohan Gupta. Look, I've already spoken to so many people from your company, and frankly, I'm very frustrated. I'm getting calls at all hours, multiple times a day. Is there no record of my conversations? I need to speak to someone senior, a manager who can actually understand my situation. Agent: Mr. Gupta, I understand your concern about the call frequency. I assure you that we are trying to reach you to understand the repayment difficulties you're facing. My records show that the due amount is indeed 35,000 and is overdue by 60 days. Can we discuss a payment plan or a partial payment that you can manage right now? Customer: No, no, I'm not going to repeat myself to another agent. I've explained everything before. I need a manager. My request is very clear. If I don't get to speak to a senior person, or if these incessant calls don't stop, I will have no option but to take this up with the RBI and the consumer forum. I'm serious about this. Agent: Mr. Gupta, I am logging your request to speak with a senior officer. Please allow me some time to transfer your details to the escalation team. You will receive a call back within 24 to 48 hours from a manager. And I'm making a note regarding the call frequency. Thank you for your feedback. Customer: Alright, please ensure this happens. I don't want any more standard calls. I need someone to call me who has the authority to actually resolve this. Agent: Noted, Mr. Gupta. Your escalation request is in process. Is there anything else I can assist you with at this moment regarding the account status? Customer: No, just get the manager to call me.

Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Rajendran Krishnan? My name is Pooja from Axis Bank regarding your personal loan account number ending in 8976.
Customer: (Struggling to understand) Hello? Who is calling? I cannot understand properly.
Agent: Sir, this is Pooja from Axis Bank. We are calling about your personal loan. The EMI for this month, which was due on the 5th of November, has not been paid. The outstanding amount is INR 12,500. Are you able to make this payment today, sir?
Customer: Ahh... axis... money... but I not, uh... pay, no? What payment? I not understand... loan, you say? Which loan?
Agent: Your personal loan, sir. Account number ending 8976. The EMI amount of 12,500 rupees. It was due five days ago. Are you understanding, sir? Do you speak Hindi or any other language, perhaps?
Customer: Uh... very difficult. English very difficult for me. Only Tamil, I know well. My son will speak better. But he not here now.
Agent: Okay, sir, I understand there is a language barrier here. We are unable to proceed with the call effectively. Would you like me to connect you with an agent who speaks Tamil, or should we call back at a time when your son is available to assist you?
Customer: (Sound of sighing, then slow speech) Yes... better you call later. Maybe with my son. Or, uh... someone Tamil can talk. I not getting what you saying about EMI.
Agent: Alright, sir. We will flag this for a Tamil-speaking agent to call you back. Please confirm the best time for us to call. Should we try tomorrow evening, say, after 6 PM?
Customer: Yes. Evening call. Good. Thank you. My English not strong, you see.
Agent: Understood, sir. Thank you for your time. We will arrange that callback for you.

Agent: Namaste, kya main Rajesh Kumar se baat kar sakta hoon?

Customer: Haan, main hi hoon. Aap kaun ho?

Agent: Sir, main XYZ Finance ke collections team se call kar raha hoon. Aapke account ke baare mein kuch baat karna tha. Aapke paas ek personal loan hai na, jo abhi outstanding hai?

Customer: Haan, pata hai mujhe. Lekin abhi mujhe paise nahi hain. Bahut mushkil situation hai.

Agent: Sir, main samajhta hoon. Lekin aapka outstanding amount 1,85,000 rupees ka hai, aur aapka payment due tha 15th ko. Ab 10 din ho gaye. Kya aap kuch arrangement kar sakte ho?

Customer: Dekho, itna sab ek saath nahi de sakta main. Mera salary aya hi nahi abhi tak. Lekin <interruption> ek minute... meri wife kuch kah rahi hai...

Agent: Haan sir, koi baat nahi. Aap lo.

Customer: Dekho, main keh raha hoon, mere paas abhi 50,000 rupees alag se pade hain. Mera salary aayega next week, tab main baaki 1,35,000 de dunga. Lekin ek baat hai — ye jo interest charges hain, wo bhi bahut jyada lag rahe hain mujhe.

Agent: Sir, interest toh loan ka part hai. Lekin aapka idea achha hai. Agar aap aaj 50,000 de do, to aapka account catch up hone lage. Aur baaki amount ke liye aap next week pay kar sakte ho. Kya aap 50,000 aaj hi de sakte ho?

Customer: Haan, main de sakta hoon. Lekin ek problem hai — mera bank account abhi freeze hai. Meri bank ne kaha hai ki KYC ke liye check kar rahe hain. Kya main cheque de sakta hoon?

Agent: Cheque bhi theek hai sir, lekin uske liye 3-4 din lag sakte hain clear hone mein. Aur ek aur option hai — aap kisi dost ke account se transfer kar sakte ho, ya branch mein cash deposit kar sakte ho?

Customer: Haan, branch mein deposit kar dunga. Mere paas ek dost hai jo jaata hai branch mein. To main usko 50,000 de dunga, aur wo aapka branch account mein dal dega. Ye sab arrange ho jayega 2-3 din mein. Fir next week salary aane ke baad, main remaining 1,35,000 de dunga.

Agent: Perfect sir. To confirm kar du — aap 50,000 rupees 2-3 din mein branch deposit karenge, aur baaki 1,35,000 next week ke baad de denge. Kya ye sahi hai?

Customer: Haan, bilkul. Lekin ek cheez aur — ye penalty charges jo lagaya hai, wo bhi waive kar do na. Maine to bas late ho gaya, galti ki nahi.

Agent: Sir, penalty ke baare mein main apne supervisor se baat kar dunga. Lekin aapke payment commitment ke liye main ek schedule bana dunga. Aapka name aur contact number confirm kar du?

Customer: Rajesh Kumar. Aur number ye hi hai jo call aya hai.

Agent: Bilkul sir. To aapka schedule yeh hai — 50,000 rupees 2-3 din mein branch deposit, aur baaki 1,35,000 rupees next week. Hum aapko reminder call karenge after salary credit. Kya ye theek hai?

Customer: Haan, theek hai. Bas ek baat — agar koi problem ho, to main aapko call kar dunga.

Agent: Bilkul sir, aapka number mere paas hai. Thank you for committing to this payment plan, sir. Hum aapki madad karenge.

Customer: Theek hai. Thank you.

Agent: Aapka din mangal rahe, sir. Goodbye.

This is Akash here, from Axis Finance. Main aapko aapke personal loan account number, it's ending with 8765, uske liye call kar raha hoon.Customer: Achha, ji, okay.Agent: Yes. Our records are showing, actually, that your EMI of, uh, fifteen thousand five hundred... Rs. 15,500, jo 5th July ko due tha... it got, you know, it bounced due to insufficient funds, the ECS.Customer: Arre, haan, haan Akash, I was actually expecting your call. Yaar, this month my salary was thoda late, na? Toh I couldn't, uh, I couldn't keep the balance. Bohot sorry for that, really.Agent: I-I understand, Mr. Sharma, not an issue. We can, um, we can definitely try to re-present the ECS again for the same amount, that 15,500. Uh, so, by when can you confirm that the funds will be, uh, you know, available? Your salary, it usually comes by the 12th or 13th, correct? So, 15th July, pakka?Customer: Haath, haan, the 12th or 13th, pakka, my salary should be in. Toh, uh, 15th... 15th should work, Akash. But... will there be any bounce charges for this, yaar? This... this happens sometimes.Agent: Yes, Mr. Sharma, unfortunately, yes, there *will* be a standard bounce fee. It's, uh, four hundred rupees, as per the loan terms. That will just be added to your current outstanding. So, just to confirm again, we will, uh, schedule the re-presentation for the 15th of July, for Rs. 15,500. Can I confirm your agreement to this date, and that you will, uh... you will ensure sufficient balance?Customer: Yes, Akash, please go ahead. Re-present it for the 15th, no problem. I will make sure the funds are... uh, will be there, ji. And I, I understand about the bounce fee also. Just... make sure it processes, theek hai? No more trouble.Agent: Absolutely, Mr. Sharma, you just, uh... ensure the balance is there. We will schedule it, theek hai, for the 15th. Anything else I can, uh, assist you with today, Mr. Sharma?Customer: No, no, that's it for now. Thank you, thank you.Agent: Thank you for your time, Mr. Sharma. Have a good day.

Kahiye.Agent: Mr. Sharma, aapka personal loan account number XXXXX1234 ka EMI due hai. Total outstanding amount 32,500 rupees hai jismein penalties bhi include hain. Aapka payment due date 5th August tha.Customer: Arre madam, yeh fir se wahi call. Main kitni baar aap logon ko bata chuka hoon ki maine EMI ka payment last week hi kar diya tha! Aap log check kyon nahi karte? Har din 2-3 baar call aata hai!Agent: Mr. Sharma, humare system mein abhi tak koi payment reflect nahi ho raha hai. Kya aapke paas koi payment reference number hai jo aap share kar sakein? Ya kis method se payment kiya tha aapne?Customer: Maine UPI se kiya tha aur reference number abhi dhundhna padega. Lekin yeh har roz call karna kya matlab hai? Ek toh yeh penalty alag se laga rakhi hai, woh main nahi dunga. Main jab check kar raha hoon toh account mein balance bhi toh difference aa raha hai, aapka system sahi nahi dikha raha hai.Agent: Sir, agar payment pending hai toh policies ke hisaab se penalties lagti hain. Humare record ke mutaabik aapka amount outstanding hai. Hum aapko isiliye baar-baar contact kar rahe hain taaki aapka account settled ho jaaye.Customer: Ye toh kuch zyada hi ho raha hai! Pehle toh system mein amount galat dikhta hai, fir upar se penalties laga dete ho, aur uske baad harassment ke liye itni calls! Aapka kaam sirf phone pe pareshan karna nahi hai. Agar mere account mein issue hai aur maine payment kiya hai toh verify kyon nahi karte? Mujhe yeh sab sunne mein koi interest nahi hai. Ya toh aap sahi se resolve karo yeh matter, nahi toh mujhe aapke senior se baat karni hai, ya fir mujhe grievance cell ka number dijiye.Agent: Mr. Sharma, main aapki baat sunn rahi hoon. Main aapki complaint note kar leti hoon regarding call frequency aur amount dispute. Main aapko apne senior se connect karne ki request raise karti hoon.Customer: Haan, please kariye. Mujhe aap logon ke roj ke calls aur wrong information se tang aa chuka hoon. Mujhe written mein confirmation chahiye ki is par action liya jaayega aur yeh penalties remove honge.
Customer: Is number ka phone switched off hai ya coverage area se bahar hai. Please baad mein try karein.

Agent: Namaste, mera naam Vikram hai, Axis Bank se baat kar raha hoon. Kya main Mr. Suresh Kumar se baat kar sakta hoon?
Customer: Jee, main Suresh Kumar hi bol raha hoon. Kahiye.
Agent: Suresh ji, aapka Axis Bank loan account number 7891XXXXX456 hai, uski EMI Rs. 18,500 due hai jo 10 din se over due hai. Kya aapko iske baare mein jaankari hai?
Customer: Jee haan, mujhe pata hai. Main pay karna chahta hoon par thodi dikkat ho rahi hai. Actually, mera jo account hai jisme funds hain, woh joint account hai meri wife ke saath, Mrs. Priya Kumar. Aur abhi woh ghar par nahi hain, woh shaadi mein gayi hain, isliye approval nahi mil pa raha. Unki sign ya OTP chahiye hota hai online transactions ke liye bhi jab amount bada ho.
Agent: Oh, I see. Toh jab tak woh nahi aati, aap payment nahi kar payenge? Koi aur tareeka nahi hai, jaise net banking se? Ya kya hum abhi partially pay kar sakte hain?
Customer: Dekhiye, main chahta toh hoon pura payment abhi kar doon. Lekin woh abhi wapas shayad ek-do din mein aayengi, ya phir shayad Sunday tak. Tab tak toh main kuch nahi kar sakta. Mera salary account dusra hai par usme itna balance nahi hai abhi. Toh wait hi karna padega. Aap ek baar Sunday ke baad phone kar lenge?
Agent: Thik hai Suresh ji. Main aapka point samajh raha hoon. Toh hum ek kaam karte hain, aapki wife Priya ji kab tak waapas aa jayengi, koi idea hai?
Customer: Hmm, most probably Sunday evening tak aa jaayengi. Toh Monday morning ya dopahar mein aap phone kar lijiyega. Main unse baat karke confirm kar doonga.
Agent: Bilkul, toh main Monday dopahar ko approx 12 baje aapko fir se call karta hoon. Tab tak aap unse confirm kar lenge na. Aap payment ki taraf se committed hain na?
Customer: Jee haan, bilkul. Commitment meri taraf se puri hai, bas bank ki jo formalities hain woh unki wajah se ruk raha hai. Aap Monday ko call kar lijiye.

Customer: I have everything documented. I am also consulting with my lawyer about this. If this is not corrected I will file a complaint with the RBI Banking Ombudsman. This wrong reporting is affecting my credit score and I cannot get other facilities.
Agent: I hear you Sunita Rao. I will escalate this to our credit bureau reconciliation team as a priority. You should get an update in 3 working days.
Customer: I need it in writing. And until the bureau entry is corrected, no further payments from my side.

Customer: Haan, mujhe pata hai Vivek ji, ki payment pending hai. Mai bhi soch raha tha karne ki. Par issue yeh hai ki mera jo account hai jisse EMI jaani hai, woh joint account hai meri wife Priya ke saath. So, bina unke approval ke main process nahi kar pa raha hu.<interruption> Baaki paise mere paas ready hain, uski tension nahi hai.
Agent: Main samajh gaya sir. Toh Priya ma'am kab tak wapas aa jaayengi ya kab tak available hongi, taaki hum payment karwa sakein?
Customer: Main expect kar raha hu ki kal shaam tak ya parso subah tak woh return ho jayengi. Ya main unhe call karke bolunga ki approve kardein, agar unke paas net access ho. Toh aap aisa karo, aap parso subah around 11 baje call kar lena mujhe. Tab tak main unse confirm karke bata paunga.
Agent: Theek hai Mr. Sharma. Main aapke account par parso, yaani ki 22nd May ko, 11 AM par follow-up set kar deta hu. Please aap tab tak Priya ma'am se coordinate kar lijiye payment ke liye. Aap humein online bhi payment kar sakte hain ya fir UPI ka link main aapko SMS kar sakta hu?
Customer: Nahi, theek hai, aap 11 baje call karna, main bata dunga tab tak. Aur haan, yeh confirm karna ki koi extra late fees toh nahi lagengi is delay pe?
Agent: Ji, uske regarding aapko poori information next call par mil jaayegi, Mr. Sharma. Abhi aap sirf payment ka process ready rakhiye. Dhanyawaad.

transcript:
Agent: Namaste, Rajesh Sharma bol raha hoon, XYZ Finance se. Kya main Vikram Desai se baat kar sakta hoon?

Customer: Haan, I know, I know. Look, the cheque I gave for this payment, it bounced. The bank returned it saying there was some issue with the account — a temporary hold or something. I was very frustrated, yaar. But the hold is cleared now, the funds are there.

Agent: I see. So the account is clear now and you have the funds available?

Customer: Yes, yes, the balance is there. But I'm worried about the bounce. Will there be any penalty charges added? And what about my credit score? I don't want this to affect my credit rating.

Agent: That's a valid concern, Vikram. Yes, there is a bounce fee of 750 rupees that has been applied to your account as per the bank's policy. So the total amount now due is 23,250 rupees. Customer: <interruption> Re-present the same cheque? Is that even possible? I mean, won't the bank reject it again?

Customer: The cheque is dated the 15th of this month. It's still valid. But if we re-present it now, on the 18th, won't there be a problem? The cheque is post-dated to the 15th, which is already past.

Agent: Ah, I see the issue. Yes, a post-dated cheque dated the 15th cannot be presented on the 18th — that would be stale. We have two options now. Either you write a new cheque dated for tomorrow, the 19th, or we can schedule the re-presentation for a date that aligns with your cheque date. What would you prefer?

Customer: Writing a new cheque will take time. I have the old one here. Can we just re-present it if I write a new date on it? Or should I write a completely new cheque?

Customer: Okay, okay, I can do that. I will write a new cheque dated the 19th for 23,250 rupees. When will you present it?

Agent: Perfect, Vikram. I will schedule the re-presentation for the 19th itself. That way, the cheque date aligns with the presentation date and there will be no delays. I'm noting down here that you have agreed to provide a fresh cheque dated the 19th of this month for the amount of 23,250 rupees, which includes the original EMI of 22,500 and the bounce fee of 750. We will present this cheque on the 19th, and once it clears, your account will be fully settled. Is that correct?

Customer: Yes, that's correct. I will write the cheque today itself and make sure the balance is maintained in my account. I don't want any more bounces. Please don't call me again unless there is an issue after the 19th.

Agent: Understood, Vikram. I will make a note on your account that re-presentation is scheduled for the 19th with a fresh cheque. You will not receive any calls from us until after that date unless there is an urgent matter. Thank you for your cooperation, and we look forward to the cheque clearing successfully.

Customer: Thank you. Goodbye.

Agent: Goodbye, Vikram. Take care.

transcript: Customer: Jis number pe aap call kar rahe hain, wo abhi available nahi hai. Please thodi der baad try karein.

Agent: Good morning, am I speaking to Rajesh Kumar? This is Priya from the collections team at Fintech Solutions.

Customer: Haan, yes, speaking. But look, I... I'm not in a good position right now to talk about payment, yaar.

Agent: I understand, Rajesh. I'm calling regarding your loan account ending in 4827. You have an outstanding balance of Rs. 1,84,000 and your EMI was due on the 15th of this month. It's now the 22nd. Can we discuss your payment plan?

Customer: See, the thing is... <interruption> my company, they shut down operations last month. Completely shut down. I was working as a senior executive there for eight years, and suddenly they... they just closed everything down. No notice, nothing proper.

Agent: Oh, I see. So you've recently lost your job?

Customer: Yes, lost my job. And my salary for last month? Still pending. The management says they have cash flow issues, so they cannot release salaries. Already two months without proper income, Priya. My wife is asking me every day how we will manage the kids' school fees, the house rent...

Agent: I'm sorry to hear that, Rajesh. This is a difficult situation. But let me ask you — do you have any savings or alternate source of income right now?

Customer: Savings? Haan, I have some, maybe Rs. 30,000 or 40,000 in the bank, but that's for emergency. If I use that for your loan, what will I do for the next month? My wife's salary is only Rs. 25,000, and that goes to rent and school fees and groceries. Everything is stretched, you understand?

Agent: Yes, I understand. Have you been looking for another job?

Customer: Of course I'm looking! I've sent out maybe 50 resumes in the last month. I have two interviews lined up next week, but nothing confirmed yet. And even if I get a job, there's a notice period — at least 30 days before I start earning again. So realistically, I'm looking at maybe two months before I can start making payments again.

Agent: Okay, Rajesh. So you're facing a temporary income disruption due to the job loss. Have you considered approaching the previous employer or their creditors for the outstanding salary?

Customer: I tried! The management office is basically shut. The owner is not responding to calls. I went there personally yesterday — the office is locked. It's a mess.

Agent: I see. And your wife's income of Rs. 25,000 — that's really just covering your basic expenses?

Customer: Exactly. Rent is Rs. 18,000, school fees are Rs. 5,000, groceries maybe Rs. 3,000, utilities... by the time we pay everything, there's nothing left. Your EMI of Rs. 18,000 — where am I supposed to get that from right now?

Agent: I understand, Rajesh. This is a genuine hardship case. Let me be honest with you — based on what you've told me, your income has been disrupted and you don't have the capacity to pay the full EMI right now. But I need to ask: do you have any other loans or EMIs you're paying?

Customer: Yes, there's a home loan. That's Rs. 12,000 per month. So between your EMI and the home loan, it's Rs. 30,000. My wife's salary is Rs. 25,000. You tell me how I manage?

Agent: That's a real squeeze. So you're overextended even before the job loss. Rajesh, I want to help you here. What I'm going to do is escalate your account for a hardship assessment. We can look at options like a temporary moratorium or restructuring your EMI, but I need to verify your situation first. Can you provide me with documentation — your termination letter, your wife's salary slip, and any correspondence from your previous employer about the pending salary?

Customer: I have the termination letter. I have my wife's salary slips from the last three months. As for the employer, I don't have anything in writing — they just stopped coming to the office. I can get you whatever else you need, but it will take a few days.

Agent: That's fine. Send me the termination letter and your wife's last three salary slips. Once I have that, I'll escalate this to our hardship team. In the meantime, Rajesh, can you commit to paying something — even a partial amount — in the next 10 days? Maybe Rs. 10,000 or 15,000 from your savings, just to show good faith?

Customer: Priya, I really can't spare that right now. If I do that, I won't be able to pay the rent by the end of the month. I'm not refusing to pay you — I'm telling you I genuinely cannot right now. But once I get a job or once the previous company pays my pending salary, I promise I will clear this. I just need some time.

Agent: I hear you, Rajesh. I'm not going to pressure you for a payment you can't make. What I'll do is flag your account for a 60-day hardship moratorium pending documentation. This means no late fees will accrue for the next 60 days while we assess your situation. But I need you to send those documents within the next three days — termination letter and salary slips. Can you do that?

Customer: Yes, yes, I can do that. I'll send them by email tomorrow or day after. Thank you for understanding.

Agent: You're welcome. And Rajesh, if your situation improves before the 60 days — if you get a job or receive your pending salary — please let me know immediately. Agent: "Shukriya. Aapka din shubh ho."

Agent: Good morning, Mr. Sharma? My name is Pooja from LoanX Financials. Am I speaking with Mr. Rajesh Sharma, customer ID 7890XXX for your personal loan, which is overdue? Customer: Yes, speaking. Good morning, Pooja. Yes, that's me. Agent: Thank you for confirming, Mr. Sharma. I am calling regarding your personal loan account. We show that your EMI of 25,000 rupees for the month of July was due on the 5th and is still showing outstanding. Could you please let us know your plans for clearing this payment today? Customer: Oh, yes, I know about the EMI. I'm actually quite worried about it, Pooja. I genuinely want to pay, you see, but my main bank account, the one with HDFC, it's currently on hold. It's not frozen by any court or anything, but the bank put some temporary block because they asked for updated KYC documents. I sent them everything already, but it's still showing 'account on hold'. I literally can't do any transactions from it. Agent: I understand, Mr. Sharma. This sounds very inconvenient. So, to confirm, your HDFC account is on a temporary hold specifically due to a KYC compliance issue, preventing any outgoing transactions? Do you have any idea from your bank when this might be resolved? Customer: Yes, exactly. I called them just yesterday, and they said 'within two to three working days', but I haven't received any concrete confirmation yet. And just my luck, my salary just credited into that same account, which makes it even more frustrating, no? All my funds are there, but I can't access them at all. Agent: I completely get your situation, Mr. Sharma. We can certainly note this operational blockage from your bank's side. However, the EMI is now overdue. Do you have any other active bank account, perhaps with another bank like ICICI or SBI, from which you could initiate this payment? Or, alternatively, could you consider a cash deposit at one of our partner branches today? We also accept UPI payments through various apps. Customer: No, Pooja, honestly, this HDFC account is my main one for all transactions. All my funds are there. I don't really have another account with sufficient balance for such a large EMI amount right now. And going to a branch to deposit cash might be quite difficult with my work schedule today, I'm quite tied up. Agent: Alright, Mr. Sharma. So, just to clarify, your primary bank account is inaccessible due to the bank's KYC process, and at this moment, you don't have an alternate method to make the payment. You are willing to pay, but it's operationally blocked by the bank. Is that correct? Customer: Yes, that is absolutely correct. I wish I could clear it today itself, but it's just not possible until HDFC releases my account. I'm actively following up with them. Agent: Understood, Mr. Sharma. We will log this as an 'Operational Blockage – Account/Banking Hold' due to your bank's KYC issue. I advise you to urgently follow up with HDFC Bank to expedite this resolution. I will schedule a follow-up call for you in three working days from now, let's say on Tuesday, around the same time of day. Hopefully, your account will be active by then, and you can process the payment without further delay. Please remember that interest charges will continue to accrue during this period. Customer: Okay, Pooja. Please do call me on Tuesday. I will try my best to get this resolved from my bank's end as soon as possible. Thank you for understanding. Agent: You're welcome, Mr. Sharma. Have a good day. We look forward to speaking with you on Tuesday. Goodbye. Customer: Bye.

Agent: Namaste, main Rajesh bol raha hoon Fintech Solutions se. Kya main Shri Vikram Sharma se baat kar sakta hoon?

Customer: Haan, main hi Vikram bol raha hoon. Kya baat hai?

Agent: Vikram ji, main aapke loan account ke baare mein call kar raha hoon. Account number 7834-5621-9847. Aapka outstanding balance abhi 2,47,500 rupees hai aur EMI due date 15th ko tha. Kya aap is baare mein aware hain?

Customer: Haan, haan, main jaanta hoon. Lekin mujhe ek legal notice mila tha na, do hafta pehle. Usme likha tha ki mujhe 30 din mein pura paisa dena padega, warna court mein case hoga. Kya yeh sach hai?

Agent: Bilkul, Vikram ji. Aapne notice receive kiya, yeh bahut important hai. Toh aap acknowledge kar rahe ho ki notice aapko mil gaya, haan?

Customer: Haan, notice toh mil gaya. Mere ghar par ek aadmi aaya tha, usne notice de gaya. Lekin mujhe samajh nahi aa raha ki yeh sab kaise hua. Mera EMI toh sirf 18,500 rupees mahine ka tha na, aur maine 3-4 mahine se payment nahi kiya. Lekin kya itna bada case banana padega?

Agent: Vikram ji, aapka account 95 days overdue hai. Isliye legal notice issue kiya gaya tha. Lekin ab aap mujhe batao — kya aap is notice ko dispute kar rahe ho, ya aap acknowledge kar rahe ho ki notice aapko mil gaya?

Customer: Nahi nahi, dispute nahi kar raha. Notice toh mil gaya, that's confirmed. Lekin mujhe thoda time chahiye. Mera business abhi thoda slow chal raha hai. Agar aap mujhe 45 din aur de do, toh main pura paisa de dunga. Abhi toh mera cash flow theek nahi hai.

Agent: Samajh gaya, Vikram ji. Toh aap confirm kar rahe ho ki aapne legal notice receive kiya hai, aur aap is notice ko acknowledge kar rahe ho. Yeh bilkul clear hai. Lekin 45 din toh bahut zyada time hai. Legal notice mein likha tha 30 din, haan?

Customer: Haan, 30 din likha tha. Lekin mujhe thoda aur time chahiye na. Mere supplier se payment aane wala hai next month ke shuru mein. Agar aap 45 din de do, toh main 2,47,500 pura de dunga. Aur agar nahi de sakte ho, toh mujhe kya karna chahiye?

Agent: Vikram ji, 45 din ke baare mein main apne senior manager se baat kar lunga. Lekin pehle aap mujhe confirm karo — aap legal notice ko acknowledge kar rahe ho, aur aap is notice ke against koi dispute nahi kar rahe, sahi?

Customer: Haan, bilkul. Notice toh mujhe mil gaya, usme likha tha 30 din. Mujhe koi dispute nahi hai notice ke saath. Bas mujhe thoda extra time chahiye, bas itna hi.

Agent: Perfect, Vikram ji. Toh aapne legal notice acknowledge kiya hai, aur aap koi dispute nahi kar rahe. Aapne request kiya hai 45 din ka time, lekin notice mein 30 din likha tha. Main is baare mein apne manager se baat kar lunga aur aapko callback dunga. Kya aapka yeh phone number theek hai — 98765-43210?

Customer: Haan, yeh number theek hai. Lekin jaldi callback de dena. Mujhe tension ho raha hai is case ke baare mein.

Agent: Bilkul, Vikram ji. Main aapko 24 ghante mein callback dunga. Aapne legal notice acknowledge kiya hai, aur aapne 45 din ka time request kiya hai. Main is baare mein apne senior se baat kar lunga aur aapko inform kar dunga. Kya aur kuch chahiye?

Customer: Nahi, bas yeh hi. Jaldi callback de dena please.

Agent: Bilkul, Vikram ji. Thank you. Aapka case legal team ko escalate kar dunga. Goodbye.

Agent: "Hello, good morning. Am I speaking with Mr. Ramesh Sharma?"

So, if your salary is expected by the 25th, can we expect the full Rs. 25,000 to be paid by, say, the 27th or 28th latest? We don't want any further penalty charges to accrue on your account."
Customer: "Actually, these frequent calls are also quite disturbing, Pooja. I got like three calls yesterday only, after my notice. I know I have to pay, no need to keep reminding me so much, you know? But okay, yes, you can take my promise. My salary will be in by 25th, I will definitely pay the full Rs. 25,000. Give me until the 29th. To be safe."
Agent: "Alright, Mr. Sharma. I totally understand your concern regarding the calls, and thank you for sharing that feedback. I'm noting your commitment down. So, just to confirm, you are committing to pay the full outstanding amount of Rs. 25,000 by the 29th of this month, correct?"
Customer: "Yes, Pooja. By the 29th, full Rs. 25,000, definitely."
Agent: "Perfect, Mr. Sharma. We appreciate your cooperation. I'll update our records with this payment promise for the 29th. You will receive an SMS confirmation shortly. Please ensure the payment is made on time to avoid any further inconvenience. Have a good day."
Customer: "Okay, thank you. You too."

transcript: Agent: Namaste, kya meri baat Ramesh Sharma ji se ho rahi hai? Main XYZ Finance se Raj baat kar raha hoon aapke Personal Loan account number 1234567890 ke sandarbh mein. Aapki teen EMIs due hain aur abhi tak Rs. 45,000 plus late fees aur interest outstanding hai. Customer: Haan ji, main Ramesh Sharma bol raha hoon. Pata hai mujhe, maine dekha tha, par abhi tak kar nahi paaya payments. Job mein thoda issue chal raha tha, aur abhi expenses bhi bohot hain. Mere paas abhi itne paise nahi hain ki pura bhugtaan kar saku. Agent: Ramesh ji, hum samajh sakte hain, par yeh amount toh abafi zyada ho chuka hai. Agar aap thoda partial payment bhi kar dein toh hum aapka account regularize karne ki koshish kar sakte hain. Aapke credit score pe bhi asar pad raha hai, aur penalties bhi lagti ja rahi hain. Kya aap aaj koi partial payment kar sakte hain? Customer: Nahi, aaj bhi nahi, aur full amount toh bilkul bhi nahi ho paayega. Main sach bata raha hoon, haalat theek nahi hai. Koi aur tareeka nahi hai kya isko close karne ka? Kuch kam amount mein agar ho sake toh? Agent: Dekhiye, Ramesh ji, agar aap poora amount bharne mein asaksham hain aur humara account kafi samay se outstanding hai, toh ek one-time settlement ka option bhi hota hai. Jisme aapko ek specific kam amount pay karke account band karne ki facility mil sakti hai. Customer: Acha? Toh usme kitna amount pay karna hoga? Matlab, kitni chhoot mil sakti hai mujhe? Aur kya uska pura breakup mil sakta hai written mein? Jaise total amount kitna tha, kitni interest laggi, kitni waive ki, sab details? Mujhe ek proper settlement offer letter milega kya, agar main interested hota hoon toh? Agent: Ji Ramesh ji, aapko ek pura settlement letter provide kiya jayega jisme sari details hongi – settlement amount aur waiver. Main aapki email ID confirm kar sakta hoon jispar main yeh proposal bhej saku? Ya aapko whatsapp par bhejna theek rahega?

Agent: Hello, good afternoon. Mera naam Vivek hai aur main AXIS Finance se baat kar raha hu. Kya meri baat Mr. Rohan Sharma se ho rahi hai?
Customer: Ji, main Rohan Sharma bol raha hu. Kahiye, kya kaam hai?
Agent: Rohan ji, aapka personal loan account number 987654321, jo ki 50,000 ka loan hai, uski EMI 5,000 pending hai aur overdue chal raha hai. Aapka last payment due date 15th February tha. Is payment ke regarding hi maine call kiya hai.
Customer: Achha, yeh payment? Iska payment kaise karu main? Aap logo ne mera CIBIL score kharab kar rakha hai, pata hai aapko? Mere baaki loans chal rahe hain smoothly, par sirf aapke is loan ki wajah se meri credit report par problem aa gayi hai. Ab dusri jagah loan apply karta hu toh rejection milta hai.
Agent: Ji Rohan ji, main aapki baat samajh raha hu. Lekin abhi jo aapki pending EMI hai, woh clear karni zaroori hai. Uske baad hum aapke credit bureau ke issue par baat kar sakte hain. Jab tak payment nahi hoga, record correct kaise hoga?
Customer: Nahi nahi, suniye, problem wahi hai. Aap log mera status galat report kar rahe ho bureau mein. Jab maine check kiya toh wahaan dikha raha hai ki mein defaulter hu ya late payment ki entry zyada hain. Jabki maine aap logo ko already bata chuka hu ki kuch discrepancies the account mein shuruat mein. Pehle aap yeh credit bureau report theek karwayein meri, uske baad hi mein koi payment ka sochuunga.
Agent: Sir, toh isme payment kab tak expect kar sakte hain hum? Agar aap aaj hi apni pending EMI settle kar dete hain toh hum credit bureau department ko query raise karwa sakte hain.
Customer: Query raise karna kaafi nahi hai. Mujhe ek written confirmation chahiye ki aap log mere credit bureau record ko rectify karwayenge. Pehle wahi ho, tab payment hoga. Ya toh aap mujhe confirm karke batao ki yeh CIBIL score issue fix karoge, then I will pay. Warna aise hi pay kar du aur aap mera record kharab karte raho, yeh nahi chalega.
Agent: Theek hai Rohan ji. Main aapki baat samajh gaya hu ki aap chahte hain ki pehle aapke credit bureau record ko verify kiya jaye. Main aapki query definitely escalate karta hu is par, but aapse request hai ki outstanding payment clear karein. Isse apki credit health pe aur positive impact hoga.
Customer: Pehle report theek karo. Ek baar report theek ho gayi na, fir main khud payment karunga. Bina uske mein nahi karunga.

Agent: Namaste Smriti Gupta ji, main Divya bol raha/rahi hoon LoanResolve se.
Customer: Haan boliye. Kal hamare ghar ek agent aaya tha aapki company se.
Agent: Ji haan Smriti Gupta ji, legal notice deliver karne ke liye aaye the — aapka consumer durable loan account 12,500 rupees outstanding hai.
Customer: Notice mil gayi hai. Main ne padhh li. Mera naya address bhi de deta/deti hoon — hum shift ho gaye hain ek mahine se. Flat 12C, Green Valley, Pune 411037.
Agent: Noted Smriti Gupta ji, address update kar lete hain. Notice ke baad 15 din mein response dena hoga.
Customer: Haan main lawyer se baat kar raha/rahi hoon. Sab properly handle hoga.
Agent: Bilkul. Koi bhi query ho toh call karein.

Agent: Hello, main Adarsh baat kar raha hoon Finance Pro se. Kya main Mr. Vijay Sharma se baat kar sakta hoon?
Customer: Haanji, main Vijay Sharma bol raha hoon. Kaho ji, dobara call kyun kiya? Abhi thodi der pehle hi aapki company se call aaya tha.
Agent: Sorry sir, woh mere paas aapke account mein 15,000 ka EMI overdue dikh raha hai for loan account number XXXXX-5678, jiska due date 5 tareekh tha. Wohi confirm karna tha ki aap kab tak payment karwa rahe hain?
Customer: Confirm kya karna hai? Mujhe pata hai ki overdue hai. Lekin 15,000 kyun? Last time toh thoda kam bata rahe the. Aap logo ne faltu mein penalties laga diye hain. Har din chaar chaar baar phone karke aur upar se galat amount bata ke.<interruption>
Agent: Sir, jo system mein reflect ho raha hai, ussi ke according main aapko bata raha hoon. Aur call frequency ke liye I apologize. Aapka amount sir, principal plus delayed charges, yeh total 15,000 hi ban raha hai.
Customer: Nahi ji, yeh sab jhoot hai. Yeh amount galat hai. Aap har din alag amount bataoge toh kaise chalega? Aur calls ki frequency itni high hai. Maine pehle bhi mana kiya tha, par aap log sunte hi nahi. Mujhe ab aapse baat nahi karni hai. Meri complaint hai aapki calling frequency aur charges ko lekar. Mujhe apne senior se baat karwani hai, ya mujhe koi grievance cell ka number dijiye. Main seedha wahin baat karunga. Aur please, next time se calls mat karna. I just want written communication only. Yeh roz-roz ki calling band karvao.
Agent: Sir, please, aap shaant ho jaiye. Main aapki complaint note kar leta hoon regarding calling frequency and the charges you are disputing. Aur mein yeh baat aage escalation team ko forward karta hoon. Main aapko revert karwa dunga...
Customer: Haan ji, karwa dijiye. I am serious about this. Ya toh ek senior se baat karvao ya written mein process batao iska. Is tarah se har do ghante mein phone mat karo.

Agent: Namaste, mera naam Aarti hai aur main ABC Finance se bol rahi hoon. Kya meri baat Mr. Ashok Kumar se ho rahi hai? Customer: Haanji, main hi Ashok Kumar bol raha hoon. Kitni baar call karoge bhai? Aur har baar mujhe poora account number, DOB sab batana padta hai. Agent: Sir, aapke loan account XXXX010 mein ₹25,000 ka EMI overdue hai, jo paanch din pehle due tha. Kripya verification ke liye apni janm tithi aur apni mataji ka poora naam bataiye. Customer: Pata hai mujhe, 25,000 pending hai. Aur yeh jo har baar call karte ho, ek din mein teen teen chaar chaar calls? Aur pichle agent ne jis tareeke se baat ki thi, woh toh bilkul hi galat tha. Koi tameez hai nahi logon ko! Mera interest amount bhi itna zyada kyun dikha rahe ho? Maine toh itna approve nahi kiya tha. Agent: Sir, woh interest aur penalties toh as per terms and conditions lag jaati hain jab payment due date miss ho jaati hai. Kripya aap confirm karein ki kab tak aap payment ka intezam kar payenge? Customer: Dekhiye, main koi payment nahi kar raha abhi. Main sabse pehle toh is baat ki shikayat karna chahta hoon ke mujhe itni harassment kyon ho rahi hai? Itni call frequency aur aapke agents ka behavior. Meri yeh baat toh higher authorities tak pahunchao, mujhe apne senior se baat karni hai, issi waqt. Aap unko mera call transfer karo. Agent: Sir, hum directly transfer nahi kar sakte. Main aapki shikayat abhi note kar leta hoon. Main aapke concern ko poori tarah se note kar raha hoon ke aapko call frequency aur agent behaviour se problem hai. Customer: Nahi, aap note karne se pehle ye batao ki mera senior se baat kab hogi? Ya phir ek official complaint kaise register karte hain, ya toh woh batao. Agent: Ji sir, aapko ek call back arrange karwaya jaega hamare senior department se. Aur aapki shikayat bhi proper system mein register ki jaayegi. Kripya confirm kar dijiye dobara se, apki janm tithi 12 February 1978 aur mataji ka naam Kavita Devi, sahi hai? Customer: Haan, haan sahi hai. Ab jab tak senior ka call nahi aata, dobara mat karna call mujhe. Agent: Theek hai sir, hum aapko call back schedule karwa dete hain aur aapki complaint register kar dete hain. Dhanyavaad.

Agent: Good morning, Mr. Rahul Kumar. My name is Sana from HDFC Bank. I'm calling about your personal loan account, it's 9876-5432-1098. We see that you have two pending EMIs of INR 18,000 each, making the total overdue amount INR 36,000, plus late payment charges. The last due date was the 20th of last month. Could we arrange for this immediate payment today itself, please? Customer: Hello, Sana. Yeah, good morning. See, about the EMI, I know I know it's pending. But what to do, your bank... listen na, your bank has totally messed up my CIBIL reporting! It's showing my account, this very loan, as ‘doubtful’ with like so many negative remarks. I applied for a car loan last month, and you know what? It got rejected! Rejected because of this HDFC bank CIBIL entry, I swear. Agent: Mr. Kumar, I understand your concern, it's important. But for now, our main priority is clearing these overdue EMIs. Once the payments are received, the account status will update, and we can then address the other points. Customer: How can I pay, Sana, when my whole credit history is, like, damaged? I saw the report. It shows this particular HDFC loan account, 9876-5432-1098, as 'written off' and 'doubtful'. And listen, my loan is perfectly active, yaar! I was always paying until these last two months there were some, like, gateway issues when I tried to transfer funds from my other account. You people are not helping. This is a big big mistake. Fix the CIBIL error first, okay? Get a confirmation of that correction, and only then... *only then*, I will pay the full INR 36,000, plus whatever legitimate charges apply. I mean, my entire home loan approval for a big amount is also waiting, because of this nonsense. Agent: Hmm, Mr. Kumar, I hear you, sir. The CIBIL reporting issues and the payment gateway problem... yes. We definitely want accurate information reflecting on your credit profile. For us to, like, verify this and officially log your dispute with our specialized team, could you please confirm your date of birth, sir? Customer: Meri date of birth hai… DD/MM/YYYY. Please verify fast, Sana. And this needs to be escalated, jaldi se. This CIBIL thing, it's impacting so much. I've already tried complaining on your website two weeks back, but nothing, zero response, nobody called. Agent: Thank you for confirming your date of birth, Mr. Kumar. Yes, it matches our records here. I have now formally logged your complaint regarding the incorrect CIBIL reporting and your request for immediate correction. Our operations team will look into this very urgently, and our nodal officer will contact you within five business days with an update. However, to show good intent and also, you know, prevent further, um, negative impact to your credit score if these continue to remain outstanding, could we at least process one EMI payment today? This prevents further escalation of your account to a much higher bucket. Customer: Nahi, Sana. I told you, I am not paying *anything* till my CIBIL report is fixed, proper confirmation comes on that. That is my absolute condition. First you sort that out, then I will pay *all* three EMIs. My current pending, I mean. It is not my fault, bank's fault for reporting wrong and damaging my financial standing. Just make sure the complaint is logged properly and I get a quick resolution, please? Email, number sab hai aapke paas for updates. Agent: Understood, Mr. Kumar. I have noted your condition regarding the CIBIL correction as a prerequisite for payment. The dispute has been flagged for urgent resolution by our internal team. We will use your registered email and phone number for all updates, as you mentioned. Please expect communication within the stated timeframe. Anything else you'd like to ask or clarify today? Customer: No, no, that's it. Bas follow up achhe se karna.

Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Rajesh Kumar? This is Priya from Credence Finance collections team.

Customer: Haan, haan, main hi hoon. Kya baat hai? Mujhe pata hai main kuch din se payment nahi kar paya.

Agent: Haan Rajesh ji, aapke account mein Rs 47,500 outstanding hai. Last payment to aapne 15th September ko kiya tha, aur ab EMI 3rd October ko due ho gayi thi. Abhi tak payment nahi hua. Kya issue hai?

Customer: Dekho, issue yeh hai ki maine apne manager se bola tha ke mera salary increment letter de do. HR ne kaha hai ki document tayyar kar rahe hain, par abhi tak nahi mila. <interruption> Maine apne co-applicant ko bhi message kar diya hai — woh mere saath joint account mein hai — lekin woh abhi out of station hai.

Agent: Samajhta hoon. Toh aap payment karna chahte ho, par kuch documents ka wait kar rahe ho?

Customer: Bilkul. Dekho, mera naya salary increment ke baad hi main poora payment de doonga. Plus, mera co-applicant Vikram ko pata chalana padega kyunki account joint hai. Agar woh approval de de, to main directly EMI de sakta hoon. Par increment letter abhi tak nahi aaya.

Agent: Theek hai. Toh increment letter aur co-applicant ka approval — dono cheezon ka wait ho raha hai?

Customer: Haan, exactly. Aur sun, Maine apne bank se bhi puch liya tha ki kya mera balance sufficient hai payment ke liye. <interruption> Bank ne kaha ki account mein thoda issue tha, some regulatory hold tha jo last month lagaya tha. That's also blocking me. Par woh clear ho jayega within two weeks, bank ne kaha.

Customer: Arre, 13th ko hi kar diya tha morning mein. Mujhe toh message bhi aa gaya tha "payment successful" likha hua. Toh aap ke paas abhi tak nahi aaya kya?

Agent: Samajh gaya Priya ji. Haan, kabhi kabhi NEFT mein 2-3 din lag jaate hain system mein reflect hone mein, especially agar Friday ko kiya tha toh Monday ko update hota hai. Aapne 13th ko kiya tha, toh aaj 16th hai... payment reflect hone mein thoda time lag sakta tha.

Customer: Toh matlab aapne mujhe call kar diya payment check karne se pehle? Itna toh basic baat tha na! Mera toh payment successful tha, receipt bhi hai mere paas.

Agent: Bilkul bilkul, aapki baat bilkul sahi hai. Mujhe sorry bolna chahiye. Kabhi kabhi humara system thoda slow hota hai updates mein. Lekin aapne jo UTR diya hai 2024021548392, main ise verify kar lunga apne banking records se aur agar confirm ho gaya toh account ko immediately clear kar dunga. Aapka payment amount toh 45,000 tha na?

Agent: Bilkul Priya ji. Main isse right now apne supervisor ko escalate kar dunga taaki bank records se match kar sake aur aapke account ko immediately resolve kar saken. Aapka HDFC account number jo aapne transfer kiya tha, wo toh aapke account mein registered hai na?

Customer: Haan, wahi account hai mera. Toh bas verify kar lo aur mera account clear kar do. Kya aur kuch chahiye?

Customer: Thik hai. Bas jaldi verify kar lo aur mujhe call mat karo isse pehle clear ho jaane tak.

Customer: I tried with two of them. One agreed to extend tenure. I am actually looking at insolvency proceedings — my lawyer mentioned that option. I am not saying I will not pay, I am saying I physically cannot pay everything right now.
Agent: Understood. Let me flag your case to our senior team who handles complex situations. They can look at a consolidated repayment plan.
Customer: Please do. I want to resolve this — just need breathing room.

Agent: Good afternoon, am I speaking with Mr. Rahul Sharma?My name is Aarti and I'm calling from CreditConnect. We're trying to reach you regarding your personal loan account, number 4001XXXX56. Your outstanding amount is INR 55,000, which has been overdue for 30 days now.Customer: Hello? Who is this? I don't know any Rahul Sharma and I definitely don't have any loan with CreditConnect. You must have the wrong number.Agent: Sir, is this not Mr. Rahul Sharma? Our records show this number, 987XXXXXXX, is registered to Mr. Rahul Sharma, son of Mr. Prakash Sharma, residing at Gali Number 3, Karol Bagh, Delhi. Can you please confirm your date of birth for verification, sir?Customer: What rubbish are you talking about? My name is Ajay Kumar, and my father's name is Suresh Kumar. I live in Vasant Kunj, not Karol Bagh. This is completely wrong! I haven't taken any loan from anyone, especially not for 55,000 rupees. I don't know who this Rahul Sharma is, but it's not me.Agent: Sir, I understand your concern. However, as per our records linked to your PAN card and Aadhaar card, this loan was disbursed under the name Rahul Sharma. Could there be any error from your end? Did you perhaps use these documents for someone else, or lose them recently?Customer: Are you crazy? Lose my PAN and Aadhaar? No way! This sounds like some kind of fraud to me. Someone must have used my identity without my knowledge. I never applied for this loan. You people are calling the wrong person and saying I owe money! This is a serious issue. I want to know how this loan was even taken in the first place, and I want proof!Agent: Sir, please remain calm. I understand this is distressing. If you believe your identity has been compromised, we can certainly investigate this as a potential fraud case. I will escalate this internally to our fraud investigation team immediately. They will require some documentation from your side to proceed. Would you be able to provide an FIR copy or any other identity proof to confirm your claim, sir?Customer: FIR? For a loan I never took? This is all so messed up! First you tell me I have a loan, then you ask for FIR. I'll need to understand what documents you even used for this loan. I am not taking responsibility for this 'Rahul Sharma's' loan. Please stop calling me, this number belongs to Ajay Kumar, and I want my name removed from your system for this fake loan.Agent: Sir, as I said, we will open a fraud investigation. I'm noting down your request to flag this account as an 'Identity Theft' case. Our team will contact you regarding the documents required to proceed with the investigation. Please ensure you cooperate with them to resolve this. For now, I will mark this interaction under a dispute due to potential identity theft, and all collections calls will be put on hold for this specific loan from our end. We will update you with the next steps from our fraud team, sir. Is there any other contact number we can reach you on, just in case?Customer: No, use this one. Just make sure no one else calls me asking for Rahul Sharma. This is Ajay Kumar, clear? And this loan is not mine. This is fraudulent.Agent: Understood, Mr. Ajay Kumar. We will proceed accordingly and escalate your concerns. You will hear from our dedicated fraud investigation team shortly.

Agent: Hello, mera naam Pooja hai aur main EasyLoan se baat kar rahi hoon. Kya main Rajesh Sharma ji se baat kar sakti hoon?  Aapka loan account number hai 87654321, jismein Rs. 25,000 ka amount overdue chal raha hai. Customer: Rajesh Sharma? Kaun Rajesh Sharma? Ji main Rajesh Sharma bol raha hoon, but yeh kis loan ki baat kar rahe ho aap? Mera toh koi loan nahi hai aapki company se. Agent: Sir, aapke account mein yeh amount overdue show ho raha hai. Iska disbursement June 2023 mein hua tha. Aapki EMI due thi November 5th ko. Customer: Ma'am, aap pakka galat number par call kar rahi ho. Ya phir shayad kisi ne fraud kiya hai. Mera EasyLoan mein koi account nahi hai, na maine kabhi koi loan liya hai. Kya bol rahe ho aap? Rs. 25,000 ka loan? Yeh kya mazaak hai? Agent: Sir, kya aap apne details confirm kar sakte hain, jaise date of birth ya full address, taaki main verify kar sakun? Customer: Verification? Kya verify karun? Jab loan hi nahi liya toh kaisa verification? Main clearly bol raha hoon yeh loan mera nahi hai. Koi aur hoga, kisi ne mere naam se banaya hoga. Identity theft ho sakti hai. Aap apni side se investigate kariye yeh fraud hai! Mereko ab is number par call mat karna, kyunki maine aapki company se kabhi loan liya hi nahi hai. Agent: Sir, please shant rahiye. Main check karti hoon... Customer: Nahin check karna. Mera number hai, but loan mera nahi. Samajh nahin aa raha aapko? This is clearly fraud! Koi Rajesh Sharma aur hoga, main toh hoon hi nahin woh banda. Mere documents kaise use hue? Aap yeh check karo.

Agent: Anita Desai ji, please ek date toh... <interruption>

<noise>child crying in background</noise>

Customer: Ghar mein bhi sab struggle kar rahe hain. Main nahi chahta/chahti ki loan kharab ho, lekin genuinely haath khali hain. Abhi kuch nahi ho sakta.

Aapka Rs. 45,000 ka amount pending hai, jiski due date 15 din pehle nikal chuki hai. Customer: Arre bhai, aap log meri baat kyon nahi samajhte ho? Kitni baar maine bola hai ki abhi mujhe contact mat karo. Already maine mail kiya hai, aur even ye number bhi maine DND mein register karaya tha. Phir bhi har din 4-5 phone aate hain, ye kya hai? This is sheer harassment! Agent: Ma'am, main aapki baat samajh raha hoon. Par aapka amount abhi tak receive nahi hua hai humein. Agar aap payment nahi karenge toh humein toh follow up karna padega. Maine clearly mention kiya tha ki jab tak mere lawyer se baat na ho jaaye, mujhe phone mat karo. Mera lawyer deal kar raha hai isko, unhone already aapko legal notice ka reply bhi bhej diya hai. Main aap logon ke aise repeated calls se tang aa chuki hoon. Maine kal hi dobara ek mail kiya hai is regarding. Agent: Ma'am, hum check karte hain aapka mail aur lawyer ka point. But payment ke bina toh... Customer: <interruption> Koi payment nahi. Aur koi baat nahi karni. Sirf DNC laga do. Aur agar dobara is number pe call aaya, toh main consumer court jaungi aur RBI mein bhi complaint karungi. Ye meri last warning hai. Mere lawyer ne bola hai ki koi bhi baat ho toh unse direct contact karein. Aap logon ne unko legal notice bheja tha, toh unse hi baat karo ab. Agent: Okay, Ma'am. Hum aapki request forward kar dete hain for 'do not contact' marking. Aapko humare side se further calls stop ho jayenge. Lekin humare legal team aapse ya aapke lawyer se contact kar sakte hain is regarding. Customer: Haan, wahi. Mujhse nahi. Sirf lawyer se contact karein. Samajh aaya? Okay. Bye. Agent: Thank you, Ma'am.

transcript:
Agent: Namaste, kya main Rajesh Kumar se baat kar raha hoon?

Customer: Haan, main Rajesh bol raha hoon. Kaun bol raha hai?

Agent: Sir, main Priya Sharma hoon from Secure Finance collections team. Aapke account ke baare mein ek urgent matter hai. Aapka loan account number ending 4827 hai, aur aapka last payment August ke 15th se pending hai. Outstanding amount abhi 47,500 rupees hai.

Customer: <interruption> Haan haan, main jaanta hoon. Lekin maine already ek email bheja tha—

Agent: Sir, samajhta hoon aapne email bheja hoga, lekin hum directly aapko call kar rahe hain kyunki ye matter urgent ho gaya hai. Aapka EMI 15th ko due tha, aur abhi September 28th hai. Kya aap payment kar sakte ho?

Customer: Dekho, main abhi nahi kar sakta. Mera salary abhi tak aaya nahi hai. Aur mujhe ye sab samjh nahi aa raha ki tum log itna interest kyun laga rahe ho. Mere hisaab se to main sirf 35,000 rupees dekar pura kar sakta tha.

Agent: Sir, interest to loan agreement ke hisaab se lagaya gaya hai. Aur late payment charges bhi lagaye hain kyunki aap 13 din late ho. Kya aap samjhte ho? Main aapko offer de sakta hoon—

Customer: <interruption> Nahi nahi, main samjhta hoon. Lekin tum log bahut zyada pressure daal rahe ho. Mere ek dost ne kaha hai ki agar aap log itni harami interest laga rahe ho to main apne lawyer ko bulwa sakta hoon. Maine already Insolvency Act ke baare mein padh liya hai.

Agent: Sir, Insolvency Act ke baare mein baat kar rahe hain? Matlab aap—

Customer: Haan, exactly. Agar tum log mujhe reasonable settlement nahi doge, to main apna legal case start kar dunga. Mere lawyer ne already kaha hai ki is tarah se interest lagna illegal ho sakta hai. Aur agar tum log mujhe court mein jaana padega, to main tumhare bank ke khilaf complaint bhi kar dunga.

Agent: Sir, samjhta hoon aapka frustration, lekin—

Customer: Frustration nahi, ye sach hai. Tum log mujhe ek formal letter bhejo jo court ke liye valid ho. Aur mujhe clear karna chahiye ki ab se sab communication mere lawyer ke through hi hoga. Mere lawyer ka name hai Advocate Deepak Malhotra, aur unka number 9876543210 hai. Aap un se baat kar lena.

Agent: Sir, main ye note kar dunga aapke account mein. Lekin kya aap samjhte ho ki agar aap legal action le rahe ho to—

Customer: Haan, main bilkul samjhta hoon. Aur main ye bhi samjhta hoon ki tum log mere number par phone karoge aur mujhe pressure doge. Isliye main clearly kah raha hoon—ab se sirf mere lawyer se baat karna. Agar ek bhi zyada call aaye to main RBI ke paas complaint kar dunga.

Agent: Samjha, sir. Main ye sab escalate kar dunga aapke legal team ke paas. Aapka account suspend kar dunga aur—

Customer: Haan, suspense kar de. Lekin yaad rakh—lawyer ke through hi communication. Aur haan, ek aur baat—mere documents mein jo address likha hai, wo abhi correct nahi hai. Main abhi Bangalore shift ho gaya hoon. Lekin ye sab baad mein sort out kar lenge.

Agent: Bilkul sir. Main ye sab note kar raha hoon. Aapka address update request aur legal escalation dono log le lenge. Dhanyavaad sir.

Customer: Theek hai. Bas yaad rakh—lawyer ke through. Aur jaldi se ye matter settle ho jaaye, nahi to court mein milenge.

Agent: Samjha, sir. Aapka call record aur legal team ko escalate kar dunga abhi. Thank you.

Agent: Namaste Rajesh ji, aap se baat kar raha hoon Abhishek se, collections team se. Aapka EMI 15th ko due tha na, abhi tak payment nahi aaya. Kya sab theek hai?

Customer: Haan haan, namaste. Dekhiye, mera account toh theek hai, par bank se ek problem hai. Mere savings account mein ek hold lag gaya hai kuch din pehle.

Agent: Hold? Matlab kya hua? Aapne to kuch galat transaction kiya kya?

Customer: Nahi nahi, mera kuch nahi hua. Actually, mere account mein ek court order aa gaya tha, RBI ke compliance ke liye. Bank ne kaha ki mere account ko freeze kar diya gaya hai until investigation complete ho jaaye.

Agent: <interruption>Court order? Kaunsa court order, Rajesh?</interruption>

Customer: Arre, mujhe properly pata nahi. Bank ne bas kaha ki ek lien lag gayi hai mujhe account pe, kisi regulatory case ke wajah se. Unhone mujhe letter diya tha approximately 10 din pehle. Maine try kiya UPI se paise nikalne ke liye, nahi ho paya. Net banking se debit karne ki koshish ki, wo bhi nahi hua.

Agent: Toh aap bolna chahte ho ki aap payment karna chahte ho, par bank account se nahi kar sakte abhi?

Customer: Bilkul. Mera intent toh bilkul clear hai. Mere paas funds hain, par account lock hai. Iska matlab mujhe 10-15 din wait karna padega jab tak bank apna investigation complete kar le.

Agent: Samajh gaya. Toh aap apna outstanding amount batayein — 45,000 rupees hai na?

Customer: Haan, 45,000 theek hai, par interest charges mein kuch doubt hai. Mujhe lagta hai extra charges lag gaye hain. But pehle toh account unlock karna padega.

Agent: Theek hai. Toh aap bank se contact kar liye ho aur poocha hai ki kab tak unlock hoga?

Customer: Haan, unhone kaha 7-10 din aur lag jayenge. Unka investigation department abhi process kar raha hai. Unhone bola ki meri ID aur address verify ho gaya, bas final clearance baaki hai.

Agent: <interruption>Toh aap mujhe callback de sakte ho na 12 din baad jab account unlock ho jaye?</interruption>

Customer: Haan, 12 din mein aap call karo. Tab tak bank ka process complete ho jayega. Aur mujhe alternate payment channel diya jaa sakta hai kya? Cheque se de sakta hoon ya branch mein cash deposit kar sakta hoon?

Agent: Bilkul. Aap NEFT se bhi kar sakte ho, ya phir branch mein jaa kar cash deposit kar sakte ho. Mujhe aapka address confirm karna hai — aap Mumbai mein rehte ho na, Andheri West?

Customer: Haan haan, same address. Par ek cheez aur — bank ne kaha ki mere account pe lien hai, toh mere savings account se transfer nahi hoga. Cheque bhi ussi account se to draw hona padega na?

Agent: Aah, samajh gaya. Toh cash deposit hi theek rahe. Aap branch mein jaa kar directly 45,000 deposit kar sakte ho, cheque receipt le sakte ho, aur hume WhatsApp ya email se receipt send kar sakte ho.

Customer: Theek hai. Par mujhe aapka ek aur chiz batani hai — ek dusre lender ka 8,000 rupees ka EMI bhi same date mein tha, aur woh default pad gaya. Mera paisa sab jagah spread hai.

Agent: Samajh gaya, par abhi humare 45,000 pe focus karte hain. 12 din baad jab account unlock ho jaye, aap branch mein deposit kar dena. Theek hai?

Customer: Bilkul. 12 din baad bank se mujhe clear confirmation mil jayega, tab mein immediately deposit kar dunga. Aur agar account unlock ho jaye toh UPI se bhi kar sakta hoon.

Agent: Perfect. Toh main aapka follow-up call schedule kar dunga 12th din ke liye. Aapka current number yeh hai na, 98xxxxxx00?

Customer: Haan, yeh number theek hai. Aur agar main early deposit kar sakta hoon toh kar dunga, par 12 din ke andar toh definitely kar dunga.

Agent: Bilkul. Aapka account hold ka status mujhe note kar dunga aur legal team ko notify kar dunga taaki koi aur pressure na ho. Aap apne bank ke investigation process ko follow karte rahna.

Customer: Shukriya yaar. Aapne samajh liya meri situation ko. Mujhe pata hai mera debt hai, par account lock hai toh kya kar sakta hoon?

Agent: Bilkul samajh gaya. Aap bank se ek written confirmation le lena jab account unlock ho jaye, aur hume send kar dena. Theek hai?

Customer: Haan, zaroor. Thank you. 12 din baad call karna yaad rakhna.

Agent: Pakka. Take care, Rajesh.

Customer: Haan, wahi hi. HDFC mein account hai, ending 4567.

Agent: Perfect, sir. To hum apne system mein schedule kar denge ki aapka cheque 20th March ko re-present kiya jayega. Aap apne bank branch se bhi ek baar confirm kar lena ki cheque re-present ho jayega, theek hai?

Customer: Bilkul, main apna branch mein ja kar poocha dunga. Aur agar koi problem ho to main aapko call kar dunga, haan?

Agent: Bilkul sir, aap call kar dijiye. Mere number likha hai on your statement. Aur sir, ek baat aur — agar cheque 20th ko clear nahi hota, to hum fir se call karenge. Theek hai?

Customer: Haan, samajh gaya. Par ab clear ho jayega. Mera salary confirm hai.

Agent: Thank you sir, aapka co-operation ke liye. Aapka case 20th March ko re-present hoga. Take care!

Customer: Haan, theek hai. Bye.

Agent: Hello, I am calling from FastCash Loans. Am I speaking with Mr. Sanjay Sharma regarding your loan account number FC00987654? We're calling about your outstanding EMI due on the 10th of May.Customer: Haan, yes, this is Sanjay speaking. But actually I'm in a meeting right now, main thoda busy hoon. Can I call you back later?Agent: Sir, it's just a quick query about the payment. Your EMI was due a few days ago. We haven't received it yet. Can you confirm when you plan to clear the outstanding amount? It's 15,000 rupees.Customer: Arre, I know. I remember the date. Actually, mera salary abhi tak credit nahi hua hai. It usually comes by the 8th or 9th, but this month it's delayed. It should come by Friday, pakka.Friday ke baad evening mein aap call kar sakte ho kya? Agent: Understood, Mr. Sharma. So your salary is expected by Friday, and you'd prefer a call in the evening after that? Let me see. Today is Wednesday. So, shall I schedule a call for you this Friday, say around 6 PM? Will you be available then?Customer: Haan, haan, 6 PM Friday is fine. Ya, Friday evening will be good for me. Us time tak salary aa jaayegi.Agent: Perfect, Mr. Sharma. I have scheduled a callback for you this Friday at 6 PM. Please ensure your payment is made soon after you receive your salary. We'll speak then. Have a good day.Customer: Thank you, bye.
