transcript:
Agent: Namaskar, main Sunil bol raha/rahi hoon LoanCare se. Kya Lakshmi Reddy ji hain?
Customer: Haan bhaiya/behen, main hi hoon. Boliye kya baat hai.
Agent: Lakshmi Reddy ji, aapka business loan ka EMI — 8,400 rupaye — 20th tarikh se baki hai.
Customer: Haan haan, jaanta/jaanti hoon. Dekhiye, meri salary 15th ko aayegi. Uske agle din poora transfer kar dunga/dungi. Pakka.
Agent: Theek hai ji, 15th note kar lete hain. Koi aur problem toh nahi?
Customer: Nahi, sab theek hai. Bas salary ka intezaar hai. Aap log please poora pending ek baar mein clear karna chahte ho kya?
Agent: Ji haan, poora 8,400 ek saath aaye toh bahut acha hoga.
Customer: Theek hai, koshish karunga/karungi. 15th ko zaroor hoga.

Agent: Good morning, Mr. Sharma. My name is Rohan from Capital FinCorp. I'm calling regarding your overdue personal loan account number PL1234567. Are you Mr. Rajesh Sharma? Customer: Yes, I am Rajesh Sharma. Good morning, Rohan. I have received your legal notice for this account. Agent: Thank you for confirming, Mr. Sharma. We understand the current situation is challenging, and we've been trying to reach you to discuss a resolution. Given the long outstanding balance of six lakh fifty thousand rupees, which includes accumulated interest and late payment charges, our management has approved a special one-time settlement offer for you. Customer: Six fifty? Oh God. See, Rohan, I know I owe, but this amount is just too much. I'm struggling right now with my business. I can manage some amount, but not this. What options do I have? Agent: I understand, Mr. Sharma. That's why we have this special settlement offer. For a full and final settlement of your account, you can pay a lump sum of four lakh rupees. This would waive off the remaining two lakh fifty thousand, clear your dues completely, and allow us to issue you a No Objection Certificate. Customer: Four lakh rupees? Rohan, this is a good offer, I appreciate it. But can we do three lakh eighty thousand? I mean, can it be reduced a little more for me? I have some funds but arranging four lakh will be very difficult, truly. Please check if you can reduce it a little more for me. Agent: Mr. Sharma, I understand your concern. This offer of four lakh rupees is already significantly discounted, almost 40% of the total outstanding. This is the maximum concession our system allows at this stage, especially given the age of the account. This offer is only valid till the end of this month, which is October 31st. Customer: Okay... four lakh. By when would I need to make this payment? Agent: You would need to make the full payment of four lakh rupees by October 31st, 2024. Once we receive the payment, we will immediately process the account closure and send you the sanction letter and NOC. Customer: Alright, Rohan. I think I can arrange for the four lakhs. This settlement is a big relief. Yes, I agree to pay four lakh rupees as full and final settlement for my loan account PL1234567. Please send me the formal settlement letter. When can I expect it? Agent: Excellent, Mr. Sharma. I'm glad we could reach a resolution. I have noted your agreement for a settlement of four lakh rupees to be paid by October 31st, 2024. We will put your account on hold and within the next 24 working hours, you will receive the formal settlement sanction letter on your registered email ID and also by post to your address. The letter will include all details for the payment. Customer: Thank you, Rohan. Please send it as soon as possible. I will make the payment as agreed. Agent: Certainly, Mr. Sharma. Thank you for your cooperation. Have a good day. Customer: You too. Bye.

Agent: Hello, mera naam Anjali hai. Kya main Mr. Ramesh Kumar se baat kar rahi hoon? Aapne 'Bank of Loans' se loan liya tha, jiska account number hai 8765-XXXX-1234. Aapka EMI ₹12,500 jo 5th October ko due tha, abhi tak receive nahi hua hai. Kya aap bata sakte hain ki payment kab tak expect kar sakte hain?
Customer: Haan Anjali ji, main Ramesh hi bol raha hoon. Pata hai, main actually pay karna chahta hoon, but last kuch din se thoda issue aa raha hai. Mera HDFC bank account, jis se auto-debit hota hai, woh abhi freeze ho gaya hai. Issi wajah se main kar nahi paaya.
Agent: Oh, I see. Freeze ho gaya hai? Kya reason hai uska? Matlab, bank ne kuch bataya hai aapko?
Customer: Haan, maine unko call kiya tha. Woh bol rahe hain ki kuch KYC updates pending hain, aur ek transaction ki wajah se unhone temporarily hold kiya hua account. Main documents jama karwane gaya bhi tha par abhi tak theek nahi hua hai. Unhone bola hai do-teen din lagenge aur. Mere saare funds usi account mein hain, isliye pay nahi ho pa raha.
Agent: Theek hai, main samajh sakti hoon aapki problem. Toh iska matlab aap net banking ya UPI se bhi payment nahi kar paayenge abhi tak?
Customer: Bilkul nahi, kuch bhi access nahi ho raha. Online toh bilkul band hai. Jab tak account unfreeze nahi hota, main kuch nahi kar sakta. Main toh chahta hoon jaldi se jaldi clear ho jaye, interest bhi lag raha hoga na upar se.
Agent: Ji, absolutely. Charges toh lag rahe honge, Ramesh ji. Aap ek kaam kar sakte hain. Jab tak aapka account theek nahi hota, agar aapke paas koi dusra bank account hai jahan se aap temporary arrangement kar sakte hain toh hum aapko uske liye link bhej sakte hain. Ya phir, aap directly humari branch mein cash ya cheque deposit kar sakte hain.
Customer: Nahi Anjali ji, problem yahi hai ki mera saara savings usi HDFC account mein hai. Dusra account toh hai par usmein itne funds nahi hain abhi ki main ₹12,500 transfer kar sakoon. Isi liye main chahta hoon ki yeh bank ka issue resolve ho jaye pehle. Uske baad toh immediately kar doonga. Main HDFC bank branch ke contacts mein hoon, shayad Monday tak ho jayega. Um, uske baad toh pakka. Aap mujhe ek baar fir se next week call kar lo Tuesday ko. Main confirm kar loonga.
Agent: Theek hai Ramesh ji. Toh aapka primary concern hai ki HDFC account frozen hai KYC issues ki wajah se aur jab tak woh resolve nahi hota, aap payment nahi kar sakte. Main yeh note kar leti hoon. Aapki situation main system mein update kar deti hoon. Aap tension mat lijiye. Main aapko Tuesday ko morning mein, say, 11 AM tak fir se call karungi. Aap try kariye bank se contact karke yeh issue resolve karwane ka. Aur jaise hi apka account unlock ho jaye, toh please koshish kijiyega pay karne ki. Humari payment link mai aapko SMS pe bhej deti hoon for your reference. Koi aur help chahiye kya aapko?
Customer: Nahi nahi, itna hi Anjali ji. Please Monday ya Tuesday ko hi call karna, usse pehle kuch ho nahi paayega.
Agent: Don't worry, Tuesday 11 AM par main aapko call back karungi. Dhanyawad Ramesh ji.
Customer: Shukriya Anjali ji. Bye.

Agent: Good morning, Mr. Shankar. My name is Maya, and I'm calling from SwiftMoney Loans regarding your personal loan account ending in 7890. Your EMI of 15,000 rupees was due on the 5th of this month and is still outstanding.
Customer: Good morning, Maya. Yes, yes, I know about the loan. But actually, what amount you are saying, it is wrong only. I have calculated already; my due should not be 15,000.
Agent: I understand your concern, sir. Our records clearly show the outstanding amount as 15,000 rupees, which includes the principal, interest, and any applicable late fees as per your agreement. Can you please confirm your date of birth for verification?
Customer: My date of birth is nineteen eighty-five, November twelve. But see, this 15,000, it is coming too much for me. I think I made a small payment earlier also which you did not include. The amount should be around 12,000 rupees, not 15,000. What is this extra three thousand for?
Agent: Thank you for verifying, Mr. Shankar. Your identity is confirmed. Regarding the amount, sir, our system automatically reflects all payments received. There is no pending payment reflected for your account that would reduce this specific EMI amount. Are you referring to any specific transaction reference you might have?
Customer: See, I told you it is wrong only. I will tell you, please, you must send me a detailed statement of account. I need to see what is the breakup, what are these charges, interest, everything. This 15,000 is showing high, very high for me. I need to check line by line.
Agent: Understood, Mr. Shankar. I can certainly arrange for a detailed statement to be sent to your registered email address. Would you like me to send it there now? It might take a few minutes to reflect. Once you review it, we can discuss the discrepancies.
Customer: Yes, yes. Please send it to my email. I will check it properly. I am saying you now itself, I owe less only. Then, once I see, I will call you or you can call me back once I confirm the correct amount. But first send the statement.
Agent: Alright, Mr. Shankar. I am sending the detailed statement to your email address: ravi.shankar@example.com. Please allow 15 to 20 minutes for it to reach your inbox. We will schedule a callback for you tomorrow afternoon around 3 PM to address your concerns after you've reviewed the statement.
Customer: Okay, Maya. Tomorrow 3 PM. But remember, the amount you are asking, I am not agreeing to it. It is too much.
Agent: Duly noted, sir. We will wait for you to review the statement. Thank you for your time. Have a good day.

Agent: Hello, kya main Vivek Sharma ji se baat kar raha hoon?
Customer: Ji haan, bol raha hoon. Kaun?
Agent: Vivek ji, main XYZ Finance se Anil baat kar raha hoon. Aapka loan account number hai 456789. Sir, aapka EMI due date 15th July ko tha aur Rs. 15,000 abhi tak outstanding hai, jisme kuch penalty charges bhi shamil hain. Kya aapko iske baare mein jaankari hai?
Customer: Hmm, haan, pata hai mujhe. Mail aaya tha.
Agent: Theek hai sir. Toh hum iska payment kaise plan kar rahe hain? Yeh amount ab kaafi overdue ho gaya hai, aur hum chahte hain ki aap ise jaldi se jaldi clear kar dein taaki aur charges na lagein. Kya aap aaj hi pura payment kar sakte hain? Hum aapko ek instant payment link bhej sakte hain.
Customer: Anil ji, dekhiye, maine already kai baar emails mein yeh mention kiya hai ki meri communication preference email only hai. Main phone pe is baare mein baat nahin karna chahta. Aur maine aapke offers bhi dekhe hain, but abhi meri koi raay nahin bani hai.
Agent: Lekin Vivek ji, phone pe baat karne se hum aapko better solutions explain kar sakte hain. For example, humari team kuch settlement options ya payment plans discuss kar sakti hai, jo perhaps aapke liye helpful honge aur aapke penalties ko bhi minimize kar sakte hain. Agar hum thoda time lekar discuss karein?
Customer: Nah, theek hai Anil ji. Jo bhi offer hoga ya kuch, please mujhe email hi kar dijiye. Aur honestly, yeh frequent calls stop kar dijiye please. I'm really not interested in discussing this over the phone again and again. Aap sirf mail pe hi contact karein.
Agent: Sir, but aap samajh rahe hain na ki account pe kaafi late payment charges lag rahe hain. Hum aapki madad karna chahte hain, please, agar aapko koi dikkat aa rahi hai payment mein toh hum uska bhi koi samadhan nikal sakte hain. Humare paas options hain.
Customer: Nahin, thank you. Bas email kar dijiye aapko.
Agent: Ek minute Vivek ji...
Customer: <interruption> Nahin, thank you. Abhi nahin.

Agent: Namaste, kya main Rajesh Kumar se baat kar sakta hoon? Yeh Fintech Collections se call hai regarding aapka loan account.

Customer: Haan, haan, main Rajesh bol raha hoon. Kya baat hai?

Agent: Sir, aapke account mein outstanding balance hai rupees 47,500 jo ki 15th March ko due tha. Aap payment kab kar sakte ho?

Customer: <interruption> Kya? Kaunsa 47,500? Mujhe toh samajh nahi aa raha. Aap thoda jor se boliye na. Mera kaan thoda... thoda problem hai.

Agent: Sir, I am saying your outstanding amount is 47,500 rupees. Due date tha 15th March. Can you pay this amount?

Customer: Haan haan, 47,500... par mujhe samajh nahi aa raha aap kya bol rahe ho. Aapka accent... aap kaunse state se ho? Aapki Hindi samajh nahi aa rahi mujhe.

Agent: Sir, I am from Bangalore office. Aapka loan amount 47,500 rupees hai. Payment kab kar sakte ho?

Customer: <interruption> Nahi nahi, aap samajh nahi rahe. Mera kaan problem hai. Aap jo bol rahe ho, mujhe clear nahi sun raha. Aapka accent bilkul alag hai. Aap thoda slow boliye? Aur Marathi mein bol sakte ho?

Agent: Sir, I understand. Aap Marathi mein baat karna pasand karte ho?

Customer: Haan, Marathi mein bol toh sakte ho na? Aapka English-Hindi mix mujhe confuse kar raha hai. Aur aapka accent... mujhe samajh nahi aa raha properly.

Agent: Sir, I apologize. Mujhe Marathi nahi aata. Mere paas Marathi-speaking agent nahi hai abhi. Kya aap English mein baat kar sakte ho?

Customer: English? Nahi nahi, English mein bhi problem hai. Mera hearing thoda weak hai aur aapka accent... <interruption> Aap jo bol rahe ho, mujhe bilkul clear nahi sun raha. Aapko kisi aur agent ko call karna chahiye jo Marathi bolte ho. Mujhe Marathi mein samajhana padega.

Agent: Sir, I completely understand. Aapko Marathi-speaking agent chahiye. Ek minute, main aapko transfer kar deta hoon. Aap hold mein raho.

Customer: Haan, thik hai. Par jaldi karna. Mera time waste mat karo.

Agent: Sir, I am very sorry. Unfortunately, hamara Marathi team abhi available nahi hai. Kya main aapko callback de sakta hoon ek Marathi-speaking agent se, shayad 2 ghante mein?

Agent: I understand you might be busy, sir. However, this is an important matter, and your account is already in a past-due status. Can you give me an exact date by when we can expect the full payment? Customer: Date? Uhm, I can't give you an exact date right now, Rajesh. Like I said, work is hectic, and I'm still sorting a few things out. Agent: Is there any specific issue preventing you from making the payment, Mr. Sharma? Agent: But Mr. Sharma, your due date was over ten days ago. Delaying it further will incur additional charges. When exactly should I expect the payment? Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Rajesh Kumar?

Customer: Yes, this is Rajesh. Who is calling?

Agent: Hi Rajesh, this is Priya from Zenith Finance. I'm calling regarding an outstanding loan account on your name. The account reference is ZF-2847-MH. Do you have a few minutes to speak?

Customer: Loan account? I don't think I have any loan with you people. What is this about?

Agent: Sir, our records show an active personal loan of 2.5 lakhs taken in March 2022. The current outstanding balance is approximately 1.8 lakhs, and the EMI of 8,500 rupees was due on the 15th of this month. It's now the 22nd, so we're calling to collect the overdue amount.

Customer: No, no, this is completely wrong. I have never taken any loan from Zenith Finance. I don't even know this company properly. There must be some mistake in your system.

Agent: I understand your concern, sir. Let me verify some details with you. Can you confirm your date of birth and your current address so I can pull up your account?

Customer: My date of birth is 14th July 1978. I live in Bandra, Mumbai. But I'm telling you, I never applied for any loan. This is very strange.

Agent: Thank you for confirming. The address on file is also Bandra, Mumbai. Sir, the loan was disbursed to your bank account ending in 4521 on March 10th, 2022. Do you recall receiving any funds around that time?

Customer: <interruption> Wait, wait. March 2022? That was... that was when my father was still alive. He passed away in April that year. I think... I think my father might have taken this loan without telling me. He had access to my bank account because we shared it for family expenses.

Agent: I see. So you're saying your father may have taken this loan using your name and account?

Customer: Yes, exactly. He must have. I never signed any documents for this. I never went to any branch. I don't even remember receiving any call from your company about this loan. How is this even possible? How did you give a loan without proper verification?

Agent: Sir, I understand this is distressing. Can you tell me — is your father still able to manage this account, or is he... is he no longer with us?

Customer: He passed away in April 2022, just one month after this loan was taken. So he cannot pay anything now. This is his debt, not mine. I should not be responsible for this.

Agent: I'm very sorry to hear about your loss, sir. This is a serious matter. Since the loan was taken in your name and the account is in your name, legally you are the borrower of record. However, given what you're telling me about your father's involvement without your knowledge or consent, this does sound like it could be a case of unauthorized use of your identity.

Customer: Exactly! This is identity fraud or whatever you call it. My father used my name and my account without my permission. I did not authorize this loan. I should not have to pay for something I never took. You should be investigating how this happened, not calling me for payment.

Agent: Sir, I completely understand your position. What you're describing — a loan taken in your name without your knowledge or authorization — is a serious matter that needs to be escalated. I'm going to flag your account for our fraud investigation team and our legal department. They will need to review the loan origination documents, the KYC process, and the authorization records.

Customer: Good. Yes, please do that. I want this investigated properly. I have not taken this loan. My father did, and he is no longer here. I should not be held responsible for his actions.

Agent: Sir, I'm documenting everything you've told me today. For our records, I need to confirm: you are denying that you personally applied for or authorized this loan, and you are stating that your father took this loan in your name without your knowledge or consent. Is that correct?

Customer: Yes, that is 100 percent correct. I deny taking this loan. I did not authorize it. My father did this without telling me. This is not my responsibility.

Agent: Understood, sir. Your account is now flagged as a disputed loan ownership case pending fraud investigation. You will not receive collection calls while this is being reviewed. The investigation team will contact you within 7 to 10 business days with next steps. In the meantime, please do not make any payment on this account.

Customer: Thank you. I appreciate that. Please make sure this is investigated properly. I have nothing to hide. I just want this cleared up.

Agent: We will, sir. Thank you for your time and for being honest with us. You should expect contact from our investigation team soon. Have a good day.
